tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'chi med grub ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ār+yā tā rā yai/ 'chi med mchog sbyin dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum// bcom ldan 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can// ston zla'i 'od 'phro yid bzhin 'khor lo 'chang*// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mar gsol ba 'debs// 'phags mas rjes bzung mchog thun grub pa'i gtso// phyogs las rnam rgyal mahā paṇ+ḍi ta// bde mchog rdo rje'i sku ru rtag bzhugs pa// ngag gi dbang phyug grags par gsol ba 'debs// sras bcas rgyas ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam// mkha' khyab stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag gser gling pa// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bod yul rmongs mun chos kyi dbul ba dag /gcig car sel byed lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum// dgos 'byung nor bu'i mdzod kyis rgyud gtams pa// dpal ldan a ti sha la= /spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston rin po che// ye shes tshul khrims 'bar ba'i spyan snga ba// zung 'jug byang chub sems 'byongs sgre pa che// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la= /rgyal bas lung bstan dge slong 'tsho byed zhabs// dus gsum mkhyen pa ras chen sangs rgyas grags// bsod nams rdo rje grub chen karma pa// mchog brnyes rin chen dpal la= /rang byung rgyal ba g.yung ston chos kyi grags// mkha' spyod dbang po thub chen de bzhin gshegs// rig ral mthong ba don ldan 'jam dpal bzang*// dpal 'byor don kun grub la= /chos grags rgya mtsho sangs rgyas mnyan pa che// mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbyangs can dkon mchog 'bangs// dbang phyug rdo rje gar dbang dharma'i mtshan// lung rig smra ba'i nyi mar= /karma chags med chos rje dul mo ba// chos kyi don grub kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung*// bdud 'dul rdo rje rigs brgya'i 'khor los sgyur// pad+ma nyin byed dbang por=

/khrid kyi brgyud pa'i khyad par/ karma chags med pad+ma kun dga'i zhabs// phrin las dbang 'byung kun gzigs shes rab grags// bstan 'dzin don grub theg mchog bstan 'phel rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= /zhes so// ngag gi dbang phyug mar pa lho brag pa// rngog ston bdun brgyud paṇa chen byams gling pa// spyan snga chos grags bkra shis dpal 'byor sogs// rngog lugs brgyud pa rnams la= /bcom ldan 'das ma bstan skyong tshul khrims grags// mkhas shing grub brnyes ba na rat+na'i zhabs// snying po'i don gzigs shākya mchog ldan sogs// nye brgyud bla ma rnams la= /rdo rje sgrol ma'i sku brnyes dze tā ri// thub dbang rgyal tshab rdo rje gdan pa gnyis// rin chen grags pa kun snying ngor chen sogs// ba ri brgyud pa rnams la= /ngag dbang grags pa paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum// mthu stobs dbang phyug lo chen dar ma grags// kha'u pa dang rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs// gnyan lugs brgyud pa rnams la= /mchog gsum rtsa gsum dam can srung ma'i tshogs// gcig 'dus skyabs kyi snying po rdo rje 'dzin// byin rlabs 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma la// mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir mngon zhen 'khor ba bde bar shes// rang don gces 'dzin dngos mtshan yang dag lta// rgyu 'bras las la yid ches mi skye ba// phyin log dri ma dag par mdzad du gsol// 'di las phyi ma rang las gzhan don dang*// las 'bras don gnyer sdug la sdug bsngal shes// don dam stong nyid kun rdzob sgyu mar rtogs// yang dag rtogs pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs// mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba dang*// 'byung ba lus 'khrugs nad kyi zug rngu dang*// chos 'gal rnam par rtog dang nyon mongs sogs// dam chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi bar mdzod// rtag brtan yun tu 'tsho ba'i 'chi med tshe// 'dod dgu nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod dang*// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mnga' thang sogs// chos mthun dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol// mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas dran pa yis// chos brgyad 'khrul pa'i 'ching ba rang sar grol// dad pa rnam dag skyes bu chung ngu'i lam// bdag gzhan rgyud la myur du skye bar shog

/bslu med las dang 'bras bur yid ches pas// lus ngag yid gsum chos spyod chos su song*// nges 'byung rnam dag skyes bu 'bring gi lam// bdag gzhan rgyud la myur du skye bar shog /byams dang snying rje bcos min skyes nas su// 'gro kun sdug bsngal khur po khyer nus pa'i// lhag bsam rnam dag skyes bu chen po'i lam// bdag gzhan rgyud la myur du skye bar shog /gnas lugs lta ba spros pa kun bral rtogs// ye shes rang gsal sgom pa tshad la phebs// chos kun sgyu 'drar shes nas rang grol spyod// spang thob med pa'i 'bras bu thob par shog /ut+pal sna tshogs 'od dang rtsibs bcu pa'i// gur khyim dbus su rab dkar lhag pa'i lha// nus pa'i bcud kyis rgyas la sems brtan pas// 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar shog /rdo rje'i lang tsho rdzogs pa'i bcom ldan ma// yang yang dran pas gsal snang rab mthar phyin// sgyu 'dra'i lha yang nā dar snyoms zhugs pa// rim gnyis dbang don ye shes brnyes par shog /'khor 'das lam gsum bcud dang dwangs ma kun// 'chi med 'od 'phro yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbus// rlung sngags rdo rje'i bzlas pas rab bsdus te// rab brtan srog gi ka ba tshugs par shog /thabs shes thig les bkag pa'i dhū ti na// snying po'i tām̐ yig 'gyur ba med pa der// srog rlung cha dang bcas pa yongs zhugs pas// 'pho bral mi phyed rdo rje gsum grub shog /mdor na 'di bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// yum gyur 'phags ma sgrol mas rjes bzung ste// mchog thun grub pa bde blag brnyes pa dang*// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang zhabs drung mchog sprul rin po che kun gzigs 'jam dpal mtshan can gyi bka' phebs ltar/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi thun mtshams su yon tan rgya mtshos bris te gsol ba btab pa dge// /maṅga laṃ//

༈ /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba dang bsnyen sgrub las gsum gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge zla ba 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ār+yā tā rā yai/ dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bum bzang las// tshe dbang bdud rtsi'i zil dngar rtag phebs pa// sras bcas rgyal ba skyed pa'i za ma tog /rje btsun 'phags ma snying gi thig ler mchod// ngo mtshar bka' babs sgrub thabs chu rgyun las// khyad 'phags byin rlabs yan lag brgyad ldan klung*// mar me mdzad dang dwags po'i bka' srol las// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor babs de 'dir bshad bya// de'ang dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i myu gu mtha' dag skyed pa'i yum mchog rjes btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas 'phral yun gyi don chen sgrub pa'i thabs bshad pa la don brgyad/ byung khungs/ rjes gnang*/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ sbyin sreg las sbyor/ bsnyen thabs kyi lag len/ phan yon smros pa'o// dang po gang las byung ba'i khungs smos pa la gnyis/ rgyud gang las bstan pa dang*/ gdams ngag gang las byung ba'o// dang po ni/ phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po phyi ma las/ 'khor lo ljang gu rtsibs brgyad pa// dngos su bsgrub bya dgod par bya// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// sngags kyi grong khyer bdag pos bskor// ljang gus srung bar 'gyur ba ste// 'chi ba slu byed dkar po'o// zhes dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud las sgrol ma ljang gu'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i 'phros su/ 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa// phyi rol mu khyud bskor nas su// dbus su thog ma tha ma ste// bzlas pa thams cad bzhag par bya// mu khyud dbyangs kyis bskor nas su// 'khor lo dkar po bsam par bya// zhes 'byung ba 'di'i khungs su sgrol mgon zhabs dang bstan pa'i nyin byed yab sras bzhed do// bod snga ma dag bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rtog pa sogs la brten par bzhed kyang 'di dang sgrol ma las

'di sgrol mgon zhabs kyis rgyud kyi dum bur bzhed cing kun mkhyen dharma ka ras kyang rgyud tshad ldan du mdzad/ sna tshogs sogs las spyir sngags dang las bzhi'i bye brag bstan mod kyi/ yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gsal ka rgyud tshig gong smos lta bu ma mchis so// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol mas dngos su rjes su bzung ba slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdo rgyud sna tshogs nas btus pa'i 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog par sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gsal rgyas su bzhugs pa de nyid paṇ+ḍi ta thu bo zhes bya bas logs su bkol ba la brten/ bod 'dir rngog lugs/ jo bo lugs/ ba ri lugs/ gnyan lugs/ nags rin lugs bcas byon pa las khyad par 'phags pa ni jo bo lugs te/ jo bo nyid dang nyid kyi bla ma gser gling pa gnyis ka'ang rje btsun ma'i zhal rtag tu gzigs shing nye brgyud stsal ba dang*/ phyogs 'dir lugs srol gyi thog ma lta bu yin zhing de las brgyud pa la da lta'i bar du spyir dngos grub rnam pa gnyis dang khyad par sku tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa zam ma chad par byon cing*/ de las brgyud pa'i bka' srol mang du gyes pa las byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa sgam po lugs kyi nang tshan karma kaṃ tshang gi bka' srol te/ 'di nyid la'ang rngog lugs gtsos bka' babs snga phyi thams cad kyi gdams ngag gi chu bo gcig tu 'dus par ma zad/ grub chen pak+ṣi dang chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje la rje btsun mas dngos su stsal ba'i gdams ngag nye brgyud kyang 'dres shing*/ phyis dus kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyang rje btsun mas nges par byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung ba'o// 'di bya rgyud ltar gtsang sbras sgrub pa'i phyag srol byung ba ni jo bo phebs pa'i skabs su bod rnamasakyis sngags bla med 'chad pa bkag pas thun mong theg pa dang sgo bstun pa'i srol ka 'jag pa ste/

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor jo bo'i zhal gzigs su grags kyang sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las dngos su bstan pas mtshon no// gnyis pa nyams len snod rung du sgrub pa rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin cing drod tshad thob pas slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i tshe/ dus bzang por sgrub mchod skabs su smos pa bzhin/ maṇ+ḍal/ sku brnyan/ g.yas su rnam bum/ g.yon tu las bum/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ phyag mtshon ut+pal dkar po'i tsaka li/ mdun tu mchod gtor/ gtor dbang dang 'brel na/ rgyab tu'ang de 'dra ba rgyan spros can/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ sbyar spos/ stegs zur par sngon 'gro dkar gtor gnyis sogs 'du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dang po bdag mdun bum gsum sgrub pa ni/ sgrub pa'i skabs ltar bsang chu byin rlabs dang sngon gtor nas brtsam bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldang*/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang bzlas pa/ rnam bum dang las bum sgrub pa bcas 'og tu 'byung ba bzhin grub nas/ slob ma rnams las bum gyi chu dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas nas mchil ma phud de phyag bcas gral du 'khod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab bran/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs nas/ phrin las bcol ba yan mdun bskyed skabs ltar grub nas/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la/

bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ bar du gcod pa dang glags lta tho 'tshams par byed cing khyad par 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad 'dir ma gnas bar gzhan tu song zhig gang mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad ni ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// oṃ sum+bha ni sogs drag tu brjod cing rol mo bsgrag yungs thun dang gu gul dud pas bskrad/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i khro bo'i tshogs du mas bgegs rnams bskrad par gyur snyam du bsam/ slar yang khro bo rnams bdag nyid la thim par gyur par bsgoms nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba kun nas brtan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu dang mtshams sbyor chos bshad rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gnas skabs tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid rje btsun sgrol ma'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du lhag pa'i lha yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu snyam pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ mdo rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa'i chos gsan pa'i kun spyod kyang legs par gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de'ang rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo 'di nyid rgyud gang las bstan pa sogs nas/ rjes su bzung ba'o// zhes pa'i bar gong smos nyid 'dir blangs nas/ de lta bu'i bka' srol khyad par 'phags pa lasabyon pa'i gdams ngag 'di la yig cha dang phyag len rgyas bsdus sna tshogs su mchis kyang da lam gyi skabs su babs pa ni/

rig 'dzin zhig po gling pa'i gter lung las/ ī shwa'i ming can cod pan nag po 'dzin// ma rungs bdud 'joms sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong*// zhal mjal tsam gyis ngan song skye sgo khogs// zhes sogs lung gis bstan pa 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku'i rnam rol dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje la ār+ya tā rā sogs lhag pa'i lha rnams kyis gsung gi gnang ba stsal nas gsar rnying sgrub thabs mang po phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mngon rtogs rin chen phreng ba dang rjes gnang gcig shes kun grol gyi lugs kyi 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub zin pas khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug bla ma dang yid bzhin 'khor lo tha mi dad pa'i drung du rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i don tu gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la yid bzhin 'khor lo yi// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir du bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pa'i mdun tu bdun rnam dag sngon tu 'gro ba'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces pas brda sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la las bum chus bran te/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po sogs/

dri ma dang bral ba/ de'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid tām̐ dkar po las sogs dang*/ yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs mngon rtogs ltar dgod pa las thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa sgoms mdzod/ des khyed rang dbang len pa po rnams yi dam 'phags ma sgrol mar bskyed nas/ da gang la dbang blang ba'i yul gsal gdab pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du bshams pa'i mdun bskyed kyi dmigs rten maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi tshom bu sku brnyan/ gtor dbang sbrel na/ 'dir bshams pa'i gtor ma dang bcas pa skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su pad dkar dang zla ba'i gdan la 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa/ slob dpon kyang yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos su gsal ba la mos 'dun drag po byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka dang*/ sku'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros mdun bskyed la phog mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka dang*/ sku'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab par byas te thim pas sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byas/ bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du byon/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par gyur cing ye shes pa phebs byung snyam pa'i ngang nas sems ma bcos pa lhod glod la/

bde ba chen po 'od gsal ba'i ngang du g.yo 'gul med par ci gnas su zhog mdzod/ de ltar nan tan du bsgoms la dri bzang gi spos dud dang 'jam rol yun ring gtang*/ snying po'i gsham du ā be sha ya ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes btags pa lan mang du brjod/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod/ des rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa song nas/ rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang lnga las de dag zhu ba'i don tu gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda' sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi slob dpon gyis// bdag la yid bzhin 'khor lo yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol// lan gsum/ de nas dang po sku'i rjes gnang ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dang khyed rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gnas dang*/ rang rang gi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ khyed rang rnams kyis slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rang 'dra'i rigs lnga yab yum phyag na bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba bsnams pa byon nas khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur bar bsam/ zhes bum pa mgor bzung la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya// ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka la sha gu h+ya pradz+nyā dz+nyā na tsa tur a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams su bzhag bum chu blud/ de ltar dbang bskur bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus kyi nang gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dang*/

khyad par lus la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad byang zhig dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pas dbur brgyan cing*/ dbang lha rnams kyang ye shes pa'i tshul du rang la dbyer med du thim pas khyed rang rnams 'phags ma sgrol ma dngos yin snyam du nges shes bsgoms/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bkra shis brjod/ rol mo dkrol/ nas 'thor/ des khyed rang rnams kyis lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi/ lus kyi sgo nas yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan/ 'bras bu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sprul sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar pad zla la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po/ mtha' skor du oṃ ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hā/ rtsibs brgyad la/ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi yig 'bru dkar po mgo gyen bstan/ kha nang du phyogs pa 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba'i rnam pa can tu bzhugs par mos/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar yang de bzhin gsal ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa dang 'od zer mdog mtshungs 'phros/ zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying gar thim pas bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur snyam du bsams la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sbyar zhing*/

phreng ba sbrel la yi ge bcu pa lan bdun/ spel tshig can lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug slob dpon la me tog gi phreng ba re phul bar bsams nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sbyar/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ sngags kyi phreng ba de nyid me tog gi phreng bar byas nas khyed rang rnams kyi mgo la bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dril bu dkrol zhing me tog mgor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sogs bkra shis brjod/ des khyed rang rnams kyis ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag ngag la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi/ ngag gi sgo nas 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan/ 'bras bu gsung dbyangs yan lag drug bcu dang ldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa'i mthu dang nus pa thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shesadang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad phyag mtshan ut+pal dkar po'i rnam pa char bzhin tu byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa'i rkyen gyis sa bon las 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

mdun bskyed las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku gsal la rdzogs pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying gar thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i thugs dang ro gcig tu gyur snyam pa'i ngang dus gsum gyi spros pa chod la gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med ma bcos gnyug ma khyab brdal gyi ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ sku brnyan mgor bzhag snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma s+t+waṃ btags pa brjod/ dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan sogs bkra shis brjod/ des khyed rang rnams kyis yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag yid la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi/ yid kyi sgo nas rjes btsun sgrol ma'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan/ 'bras bu ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// bzhi pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang ni/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la rgyan cha gtad pas dngos su rgyan cha'i rnam pa dang*/ brgyud nas yon tan gyis brgyan par mtshon pa lha 'di dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyi dngos grub thob byung snyam pa mdzod/ ces rgyan cha gtad la/ 'di ni rje btsun sgrol ma yi// dar dang rin chen rgyan sogs te// khyod kyis rtag tu bcang ba na// thabs shes zung du 'jug pa dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yon tan kun gyi snod gyur te// mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur// oṃ a laṅkā ra rat+na pa ṭa kā ya bhā saṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs bkra shis brjod/ des khyed rang rnams kyis bsags pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dag rtsa rlung thig le la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi/

rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du bsnun pa'i sgo nas lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang*/ ye shes rdo rje mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan/ 'bras bu bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa bde ba chen po'i sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*// lnga pa phrin las kyi rjes gnang ni/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed dbyer med pa'i dpral ba nas zhi ba'i 'od zer dkar po/ mgrin pa nas dbang gi 'od zer dmar po/ thugs ka nas drag po'i 'od zer sngon po/ lte ba nas rgyas pa'i 'od zer ser po/ gsang ba nas las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer ljang gu rnams 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas lngar thim/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan tu 'phros/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi/ tshe bsod ye shes rgyas/ grub gnyis dbang du 'dus/ bdud bzhi gnod byed tshar bcad/ las rab 'byams thams cad grub/ slar rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang bcas te 'od zer tshur 'dus khyed rang rnams la thim pas rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid nga'o snyam du bsams la slob ma rjes su bzung ba sogs rdo rje slob dpon gyi las rab 'byams sgrubs shig rdor dril gtad la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// phrin las kun kyang khyod kyis sgrubs// zhes dang*/ mtha' rten phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang ni/ 'di ni rje btsun sgrol ma yi// phyag mtshan ut+pal dkar po ste// khyod kyis rtag tu bcang ba na// thabs shes zung du 'jug pa dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phrin las kun la dbang thob ste// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur// oṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru wa shaṃ ku ru mā ra ya bi shwa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes lag tu gtad/ gnas skabs su'ang 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi/ mthun rkyen tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ chos bzhin spyod pa'i grogs dang lhan cig tu// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /sogs bkra shis brjod/ des khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum cha mnyam gyi sdig sgrib dag sgo gsum cha mnyam la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi/ las rab 'byams bsgrub par dbang*/ mkha' khyab rdo rje mngon tu byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi phrin las khyab pa dang rtag pa'i bdag nyid sgrub pa la dbang ba ngo bo nyid sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas yongs grags sgrol dkar sogs la gtor dbang gi srol med kyang rje dgu pas 'dam gar gsungs pa ltar da lta kaṃ tshang gi phyag rgyun tu gtor dbang yang mdzad pas de ltar spro na/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun sgrol ma gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum dang bcas pa gsal thob/ gtor ma 'di la shes dus gsum yod pa las da lta'i skabs 'dir rnam pa gtor ma la ngo bo bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos su gsal ba'i steng gi cha la bka' brgyud kyi bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin 'khrigs pa ltar khyed rang gi spyi bor byon nas nged kyis gsol ba ji ltar btab pa ltar byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad gnang byung snyam pa'i mos 'dun rtse gcig tu mdzod cig rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa sogs brgyud pa'i mtshan dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang*/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs stsol bar mdzad du gsol/

'di rnams kyi nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad dbang du 'dus/ bdud dang gnod byed ma rungs pa thams cad tshar bcad/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par stsal du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ba liṃ ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i sogs/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang lhag pa'i lha'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par mos mdzod/ ces gtor zan dngos grub tu sbyin la/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge bsngo spyi ltar bya'o// rjes chog gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs sam/ gshegs bsdu/ bkra shis bcas kyis legs par grub bo// gsum pa bdag bskyed la brten nas bsnyen pa'i rim pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan brgya'am nyer gcig sogs brjod/

sems can thams cad kyi don tu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ slar yang skyabs sems mdor bsdus su/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rang nyid yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid ces pa nas/ pad la 'dud dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum// 'chi med tshe yi dpal sbyin ma// 'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba'i// sgrol ma lha tshogs bcas la 'dud// oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ar+ghaṃ gyi sar pā d+yaṃ sbyar/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ḥ de bzhin du dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ don yid la dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags sogs sam/ phyag len du/ bcom ldan 'das ma khyod la phyag 'tshal nas// mchod pa rnam pa du mas rab mchod de// nyes gsum mthar byed khyod kyi spyan snga 'dir// sdig pa mtha' dag bshags shing bsdam par bgyi// 'gro ba'i dge legs kun la dga' bskyed de// srid zhi kun tu bcom ldan 'das ma khyod// rab bde bla med chos kyi 'khor lo mchog

/rtag par bskor bas mtha' dag tshim par gsol// nam yang khyod tshul nub med bka' drin dang*// dge kun khyod nyid kho na'i rgyur gsol zhing*// dge legs snying po'i dpal 'bras khyod dang bdag /rnam pa kun tu mi phyed nyid gyur cig /ces so// gal te tshe khrid kyis bcad tshang bar byed na skyabs sems sngon rjes gang rung rdor sems sgom bzlas rang lugs thun min/ skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sam skyabs bdun ma'i mthar dbang bzhi len cing tshogs zhing rang la bstim/ dkyus tsam la yan lag bdun pa'i rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes gshegs su gsol/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ chos thams cad rang gi sems tsam dang*/ sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug chu zla lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo// dang po la gnyis/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gsum/ yan lag bzhi ldan gyis lha'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa/ mchod bstod/ gsal brtan dag dran la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las ma bcos pa'i sems snang hūm̐ gi sgra gdangs nam mkha' gang ba dang bcas pa las rdo rje'i srung 'khor rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che bar gyur ba'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ las zla ba chu shel gyi gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po sdong bu dang bcas pa rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du a las zla ba nya gang ba rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ de'i steng du rang sems tām̐ dkar po las ut+pal dkar po tām̐ yig dkar pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog zla ba chu shel ltar dkar zhing 'od zer lnga ldan tu 'phro ba/

sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ zhi ba chen po'i 'dzum zhal can dbu la spyan gsum dang phyag zhabs bzhi'i mthil du spyan re re ste ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa mtheb srin sbyar bas ut+pal dkar po 'dab brgya snyan drung du rgyas pa'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mu tig dkar po gtso bor gyur pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan do shal se mo do dpung rgyan phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu ska rags g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang bcas pa/ lha rdzas kyi me tog du mas mdzes pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang dbang po'i gzhu lta bu'i dar gyi smad g.yogs gsol ba/ dbu skra li ba ltag par bcings pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing zla ba'i rgyab yol can tu gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su pad dkar dang zla ba la tām̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs snga ma ltar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ sprul pa'i mchod lha rnams kyis bdag nyid la mchod par mos/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin brjod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gsum pa ni/ lha snang gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pas rtag chad du ma lhungs pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag la tha mal gyi snang zhen gcod pa'i nus pa thob par bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i steng du/ 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar tām̐/ de'i mthar mdun nas g.yas skor du/oṃ ma ma ā yaḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hā/ rtsibs brgyad la/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu re/ swā/ yi ge rnams mu tig gi rdog po ltar dkar hram me mi g.yo bar gnas pa/ zhes gsal snang thon nges su bsgom mo// gnyis pa la gsum/ 'gog bzlas/ rdor bzlas/ spro bsdu dang bcas pa'i ngag bzlas so// dang po ni/ rlung ci bder bzhag sems snying ga'i yig 'bru'i gzugs dang sgra gdangs la rtse gcig tu gtad pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od zer spro/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe bsdu/ gnas pa'i tshe tām̐ la sems gtad pa lan brgya phrag la sogs pa bsgom pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bsgoms pas ngal na ngag bzlas bya ste/ de las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ sems can rnams kyi tshe spel ba sogs kyi don byas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud dngos grub thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur/

ces ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu gnas pas/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa la thun gyi dngos gzhi bya zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yu puṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes spel tshig dang bcas pa'i las sngags te thun so so'i rdzogs mtshams su brgya rtsa brgyad re bzla'o// gnyis pa rdzogs rim la gnyis/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med do// dang po la gnyis/ srung 'khor dang*/ snying gar tshe phur gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ bdag bskyed dang 'brel na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bsdu rim grub nas zung 'jug gi skur ma ldang ba'i bar dang*/ dus skabs ci bder bsgom par 'dod na 'di nyid nas 'jug ste/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu pa gur thabs su gnas shing mi mngon par myur du 'khor ba'i lte ba zlum po yangs pa'i nang du rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ rang nyid kyi steng du oṃ/ 'og tu hā/ rtsibs kyi rtsa ba sbubs stong gi thad kyi nang du mdun nas g.yas skor du yi ge brgyad bcas kyi yig 'bru rnams dkar po/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dkar po shel lta bu/ ser po gser lta bu/ dmar po pad+ma rā ga lta bu/ lcags kha tho rengs kyi gnam lta bu/ ljang gu margad lta bu/ mchin kha in+d+ra nī la lta bu rnams rim par spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ rgyal ba rnams mchod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer dkar ser dmar sngo ljang mthing gi rnam par rim par byon/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim pas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las sna tshogs pa'i dngos grub thob cing brtan par byas/ 'od lhag ma rnams 'khor lo'i gur khang gi phyi nas 'dom gang tsam nas 'od dkar po'i gur khang*/

de'i phyir ser po/ de'i phyir dmar po/ de'i phyir lcags kha/ de'i phyir ljang gu/ de'i phyir 'od mchin kha'i gur khang rnams kyang 'dom re'i bar thag can/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'khor ba'i zlum po'i rnam pa can sra ba brtan pa srub med pa rlung ser bu tsam yang mi thar ba/ bar stong thams cad ut+pal sngon po kha bye ma thag pas gang bar gyur/ yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci nus byed/ mthar 'od gsal du bsdu zhing zung 'jug gi skur ldang ngo*// 'di mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su srog pa rtsa shel gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu yas sna thig le dkar po dang*/ mas sna thig le dmar pos bkag pa/ nang snying ga'i tām̐ las byung ba'i srog gi rlung sngo dmar gyis 'gro 'ong med par gang ba la sems gtad de/ rlung bum can ci rigs su 'dzin no// gnyis pa mtshan med rdzogs rim ni/ snang srid thams cad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad srung 'khor la thim/ rang nyid rten dang brten par bcas pa'ang rim gyis thugs ka'i tām̐ la thim/ de'ang mas rim gyis 'od gsal du zhugs par gyur/ ces rnam kun mchog ldan gyi 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi nyams len rgyas pa rje dgu pa la sogs pa'i gsung ltar gnad du bsnun par bya'o// gsum pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba la gnyis/ zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba dang*/ bya ba'i rim pa gzhan bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ slar rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad don dam pa rang bzhin med pa snang cha sgyu ma lta bu ye shes lnga'i ngo bor rnam par dag go /dge ba 'di yis sogs bya/ gnyis pa la brgyad/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ maṇ+ḍal/ bstod pa/

skor ba/ sāts+tsha/ khrus gsol/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ chu sbyin no// dang po ni/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che las grub pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum mam bdun/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros lho phyogs po ta la'i ri bo nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis rje btsun ma dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis 'khor tshogs rnams la 'bul/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba kun las skyob// sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod// gang gi thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis// ma lus 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*// mgon med rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'dud// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang khyad par du 'phral yun gyi 'jigs pa las skyob cing chos spyod bzhin par yun ring du 'tsho ba'i mchog sbyin par mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas gtor mgron rnams rten la bzhugs su gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas bsdus gang 'os bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

sems can thams cad kyi don tu sems bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas sa gzhi bsrung*/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ zhes dri bzang dang ba'i rnam lnga sbyar ba byugs la maṇ+ḍal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsam/ tām̐ dkar po las 'od 'phros sgrol ma rigs bzhi yab yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su bzhugs par mos/ spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad spro na brjod/ de nas puṣ+pe ke tu'i sngags lan bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā rā ya puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas lan bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa'i phul/ spro zhing nus na gtso 'khor mtshan sngags so sor sbyar la maṇ+ḍal steng du 'bul/ nyer spyod lnga yis mchod/ bdun rnam dag bya/ de la sems gtad de yi ge bcu pa dang skabs su babs pa'i sham 'dogs bcas bzlas pa 'grub tshad byas la/ mthar 'dod don gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs la me tog gtsang sar dor/ yang zhi ba'i las sogs la sgrol ma dkar mo 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi ngo bo rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor ba yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ thog mtha' gzhan maṇ+ḍal dkyus bzhin bya ba'ang shin tu byin rlabs che'o// gsum pa ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa dang ldan pa'i dbus su dpag bsam ljon shing nam mkha' gang ba tsam gyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab yol bcas pa'i steng du sgrol ma dkar mo la/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba bskyed pa'am/ spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa la bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis sgo gsum gus pa chen pos bstod par mos la/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'khor ba las sgrol/ mtshan brgya sogs dang*/ gzhan yang gang zag khyad par can rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa'i rnam grangs ci shes pas bstod pas dgyes te mchog thun mong gnyis dang*/

khyad par 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol bar mos la 'dod don gsol/ mthar rang la bsdu ba'am mi dmigs par bzhag bzhi pa ni/ sgrol ma'i sku brnyan la sogs pa'i rten la dngos su bskor ba'am/ yang na 'gro ba'i dus su mdun gyi nam mkha' pad+ma'i sdong po rim pa gsum gyi dang por brgyud pa'i bla ma/ gnyis par rje btsun ma dang rigs kyi yum bzhi la yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gsum par sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad rin po che dang seng ge'i khri la bzhugs par mos te/ bskor ba'i gzungs sngags sngon tu 'gro bas snying po bzla bzhin tu bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis gus pa chen pos bskor ba byas pas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag gzhan gyi mi mthun pa zhi zhing mthun rkyen legs pa'i yon tan rgyas par mos/ dngos su byed na mthar 'dod don gsol/ yid kyis byed na mthar mi dmigs par bzhag phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe na'ang gzungs sngags kha bsgyur ba las gzhan 'dra'o// lnga pa ni/ dri zhim dkar ba'i sa blangs te dri bzang ba'i chus sbrus 'jim pa'i phung po'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba de'i dbus su tām̐ la rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis bskor ba las sgrol ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'am skad cig gis bskyed/ rang sgrol ma'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa g.yas 'jim pa la reg ste tām̐ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes sam/ oṃ aṃ dz+rī āḥhūm̐/ lan lnga sogs bzlas pas/ sgrol ma de rigs lnga'i rang bzhin tu gyur pa 'od du zhu ba las 'jim pa'i phung por gyur par bsam/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa/ rten 'brel snying po bzla bzhin tu gdab/ nang du gzungs sngags sam byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'bru sogs bcug la stegs kyi khar bzhag btab zin nas rab tu gnas pa ni/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sāts+tsha mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las mchod rten dkar po chen po dang mang por gyur pa'i bum pa'i dbus su pad zla la tām̐ las 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ mchog sbyin dang ut+pal bsnams pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zla ba'i rgyab yol can tu gyur/ de'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum dang thugs ka'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ tā re sogs gong gi sngags dang*/ oṃ ye dharma he tu pra bhā wā he tun+te ṣāṃ ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ sgrol ma rten bcas 'od du zhu ba las sāts+tsha'i rnam par gyur/ slar yang me tog 'thor zhing*/ rgyal mchog tshe dpag med pa'i yum// 'chi med nges par ster ba mo// rig pa 'dzin ma bcom ldan 'das// rjes btsun sgrol ma'i bkra shis shog /dge des bdag sogs sems can kun// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon zhi// tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes rgyas// sgrol ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces brjod la mchod rten gyi khang bu sogs su bzhugs su gsol lo// drug pa ni/ rab gnas byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i rten bsham/ srog chags med pa'i chu la dri bzang sman sna sbyar ba gar sla gnyis/ lde gu dang gsum bya/ sems bskyed/ bdag nyid 'phags ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la phog rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma spyan drangs rten la thim pas rten de dag sgrol ma dngos su gyur par mos/

spro na spyan 'dren tshigs bcad brjod/ dmigs pa nyid gal che/ de nas ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ swa bhā wa'i sngags bzla bzhin tu rten dbu zhabs ma log par chos skor du/ dri chab sla bas bkru/ bska bas byugs/ lde gu dbul/ khrus chu la rten 'brel snying po bzlas pas sa phyogs gtsang mar rang nyid la khrus byas pas sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma 'byung ste/ sngags can chu yis khrus byas na// lus can sdig pa dag par 'gyur// zhes so// bdun pa ni/ gtor 'bul la sogs pa gong smos de dag thams cad kyi rjes su mos gus rtse gcig pas maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga sogs las 'byung ba'i 'dod don gsol ba spyi dang*/ khyad par 'jigs pa kun las skyob par 'dod na rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas srung bar mos la/ gnas skye ba med pa'i chos dbyings na// yum rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ba bzhugs// khyed sems can kun la bde ster mas// bdag 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol// rang chos sku yin par ma shes par// sems nyon mongs dbang du gyur pa yi// mar 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sdug bsngal las// yum yang dag lha mos bskyab tu gsol// chos snying nas rgyud la ma skyes te// tshig tha snyad rjes su 'brangs pa las// mthar grub mtha' ngan pas bslus pa rnams// yum spros bral lha mos bskyab tu gsol// rtogs par dka' ba rang gi sems// mthong nas goms par mi byed par// bya ba ngan pas g.yengs pa rnams// yum dran pa'i lha mos bskyab tu gsol// de nyid kyi don la bsams byas kyang*// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mi shes pas// shes bya'i gnas la rmongs pa rnams// yum kun mkhyen lha mos bskyab tu gsol// sems rang byung ye shes gnyis med la// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis// ji ltar byas kyang bcings pa rnams// yum gnyis med lha mos bskyab tu gsol// sems mtha' bral gnyug ma'i mtshan nyid can// thabs mchog bde dang gnyis med kyang*// da dung du slob pa'i gang zag rnams// yum rdzogs sangs rgyas mas bskyab tu gsol// zhes rang byung zhabs kyis mdzad par grags pa'am/

yang na/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dbang phyug ma// chos nyid dbyings las sku phyung la// srid gsum 'gro la thugs rjes zungs// ma ltar byams mdzad lha mo khyod// tshe rabs gong nas bdag gi lha// bdag nyid sgo gsum dang ba yis// lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// zla ba'i mdangs can yid 'ong mas// nyon mongs gdung bas nyam thag pa'i// mi bzad tsha gdung gsal du gsol// pad+ma'i zhabs gdan dpa' gcig mo// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can// ma rig mun par rab 'thums pa'i// mi shes drwa ba bcad du gsol// dpal ldan ma gcig lha yi lha// rin chen du ma'i do shal can// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar ma// yid bzhin 'khor lo khyod la 'dud// bdag ni thog med dus ring nas// las kyi rlung gis rab bdas shing*// ngan 'gro mu mtha' med 'khyams te// blo mig mun pas bsgribs lags ni// da ni 'phags ma thugs rje can// bdag cag rnams kyi mig mdzod la// yang ye de 'dra'i sdug bsngal las// skyob par mdzod cig skyabs gcig ma// deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu// gang dang gang du skye ba der// ma gcig khyed dang mjal bar shog /ces rgyal ba 'brom gyis sgrol ma zhal gzigs dus gsungs pa'i byin rlabs can gyis gsol ba gdab/ tshe 'phel ba'i dngos grub zhu ba'i skabs mchog sbyin phyag rgyas 'dod don stsol bar mos la/ bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yis// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing*// bzhed don 'grub par mdzad du gsol// bdag sogs sems can thams cad kun// 'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug sogs// phyi nang 'jigs pa kun las skyobs// sdug bsngal srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol// tshe yi bar chad ma lus sol// dus dang dus min 'chi las skyobs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// nyi zla lta bur gsal bar mdzod// chu bo'i rgyun ltar ring bar mdzod// mtsho ltar 'grib pa med par mdzod// ri bo lta bur brtan par mdzod// nam mkha' lta bur yangs par mdzod// rdo rje lta bur rtag brtan zhing*// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab pas 'dod pa'i don stsol bar mos/

brgyad pa ni/ mtsho'am khron pa 'bab chu la sogs pa'i 'gram du song ste/ rje btsun ma'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang 'os byas la/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon tām̐ sogs las 'od 'phros pas yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad bkug nas mdun tu zas za ba'i phyir lhags te kha bzed pa la bdag gi mchog sbyin las bdud rtsi dang bza' btung gi rgyun babs/ ngoms par longs spyod de tshims par gyur/ ces bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba pre ta bh+yaḥswā hā/ chu thigs pa re dang se gol re sbrags/ nyer gcig la sogs pas sbyin/ de ltar byin pas kha zas zos pa tsam gyis tshims shing sgrib pa dang bral sgrol ma'i skur gyur te/ gtang rag tu bdag la shis pa brjod cing rang rang gi gnas su song bar gyur snyam du bsam/ sngags 'di 'bum phrag gsum chu la btab ste mtsho mya ngam gyi thang sogs la blugs pas thams cad tshims shing yi dwags kyi lus spangs nas lhar skye'o// thun mtshams kyi bya ba brgyad po 'di ni bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs thams cad du 'jug cing dgos pa chen po dang ldan pa'o// //bzhi pa mdun bskyed la brten nas dngos grub sgrub pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bsnyen pa sngon tu song ba'i gang zag gis sgrub pa la 'jug pa ni/ gnas gtsang ma byi dor byas shing mchod pa'i yo byad kyis brgyan pa'i gung du dkon mchog gi rten spyi dang*/ rje btsun ma'i bris sku rab gnas can bkram/ de'i mdun tu stegs gtsang khebs ldan dbus su maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng mañdzi la rje btsun ma'i sku brnyan bzhugs su gsol/ mdun tu 'bul gtor cog zlum dkar po pad 'dab bzhi pa rgyan spros can dkar mngar shing thog sogs bza' bca' btung ba blugs pa/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs mchod pa'i rigs tshar ji tsam mang bzhin legs mod/

dkyus la tshar bzhi yod na phyogs bzhir bkram/ gcig las med na g.yas skor du bsham/ 'dod yon lnga sogs mchod pa'i skabs su smos pa rnams bris 'bur gyi gzugs brnyan yod na bkod legs su bkram/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ sbyar spos la sogs pa/ sngon gtor/ rang gi mdun tu rdo rje dril bu/ me tog gis gang ba'i snod/ dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba/ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab sogs 'du bya'o// gal te bum pa sgrub pa dang 'brel na rin po che'i bum pa mtshan ldan gas chag sogs skyon med par khye'u 'am bu mo gtsang mas blangs pa'i rgyun 'bab kyi chus sum gnyis dgang*/ dri bzang dang bum rdzas nyer lnga tshad ldan sbyar ba blug mgul chings dkar po dang 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ dung chos gzungs rdor dang ldan par maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas sam rgyab tu bkod/ sku brnyan mi 'dzom pa'am dmigs bsal bum sgrub kho na byed na maṇ+ḍal steng du bkod/ rjes gnang sogs la spros pa che bar byed na las bum mgul chings ljang gu dang ldan pa'ang maṇ+ḍal g.yon nam byang shar du bzhag go /gnyis pa la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang*/ sgrub pa dngos so// dang po la gsum/ bsang chu bsgrub pa/ bgegs bskrad srung 'khor/ gnas yo byin rlabs so// dang po ni/ rang skad cig gis sgrol ma dkar mor gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan nyer gcig gam/ brgya tsam bzla zhing sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas ku sha'i 'thor g.yab bzung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab bran/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ lcags kyu'i rgya dang*/ sarba bhū ta ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron bkug

rdor thal phye bas/ sarba bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na gṛh+ne daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ lan gsum/ ral gri 'debs pa'i rgya dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngo/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin g.yon dril bu gsil la/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sngags spyod don tu gtor ma 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol la gtor ma dor/ yi dam khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phros pas bgegs lhag ma bskrad par mos la/ sum+bha ni'i sngags brjod/ yungs thun gtor/ gu gul bdug thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud bzhi sogs kyis mi shigs pa kun nas brtan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs rgyud las gsungs pa/ oṃ badz+ra te dzo badz+ra ā sa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas srung zhing brtan par bya/ gsum pa ni/ bsang chu gnas khang dang mchod rdzas la 'thor zhing*/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa rnams kyi nang du bh+rūm̐ las khams gsum gyi rdzas las khyad par du 'phags shing mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang*/ rin po che sna bdun dang*/

mchod pa'i lha mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin las kyang ches cher lhag pa rab 'byams nam mkha'i mthar khyab par rgyas par 'gengs shing*/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ so so'i rgya bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin tu/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ rol mo byin rlabs sngags lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos la bzhi/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum pa bsgrub pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba'o// dang po ni/ skyabs sems nas brtsam rjes sdud/ zung 'jug gi lha skur ldang ba yan bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar tshang bar nyams su blang*/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i skabs spro bsdu'i bzlas pa tsam gyis chog gi bzlas pa'i rnam grangs gzhan dang mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim sogs skabs 'dir mi dgos so// gnyis pa la lnga/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi rten bskyed pa/ mgron thabs kyi tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa/ tshogs bsags/ mchod bstod/ bzlas pa yan lag dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor dang rten bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ gi sgra gdangs nam mkha' gang ba zhes pa nas/ rang sems zhes dang*/ rang nyid ces pa dor/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar gong nas/ spos rol mos gus bcas/ oṃ thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten dbang po'i sras mo mchog /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma 'dir gshegs gsol// sgyu 'phrul 'dzin ma chos kyi sku// chos dang de bzhin longs spyod rdzogs// srid zhi kun tu rnam 'phrul ma// deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// rdo rje sems ma bde chen yum// don dam phyag rgya chen mo'i sku// gdod nas dri bral gsang chen ma// gnyis med ro mnyam gshegs su gsol// 'gro 'ong med kyang 'gro 'ong ltar// ston mdzad phrin las rgya mtsho'i gter// don gnyis mtha' dag 'grub mdzad ma// thugs rje mnga' ba 'dir gshegs gsol// oṃ gu ru ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes spyan drang*/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs sngags tsam gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ legs so bcom ldan 'das ma khyod// brtse bas 'dir ni gshegs pa las// bdag cag skal dang ldan mdzad de// byang chub snying por rab brtan gyur// lha dang lha min sogs dbang po// bye ba'i gtsug gis rab btud pa'i// gdan khri mchog tu mdzes pa 'dir// dgyes ldan rtag par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ gu ru ār+yā tā rā pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon sogs/ bdag la zhes par lha la zhes bsgyur te/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang gi tshogs thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la rtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// sogs sh+lo ka gnyis dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ gsum pa ni/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa'i rigs sam/ yang na/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs nas/

'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags bya/ rjes gnang dkyus ma'i skabs sa bcad gnyis pa dang gsum pa 'di dag mi dgos shing gong gi spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ 'og gi mchod bstod kyang mdor bsdus pa tsam las brjod mi dgos so// bzhi pa la bcu ste/ dang po mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngags lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa chu gnyis nyer spyod 'bul ba ni/ tshigs bcad gang yang rung ba brjod pas chog mod kyi/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba gsung rgyun gyis kha bskangs pa dang bcas pa ltar na/ lha yi chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan sogs// gtsang zhing yid 'ong mchod yon rmad byung ba// rab 'byams zhing rnams gang bar sprul byas te// 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas rnams mchod// oṃ ār+yā tā rā gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ de bzhin tu mchod yon gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ zhes dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ sbyar/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlab pa yi// phye ma'i phur ma bdug pa'i bye brag rnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥbadz+ra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra= gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams= de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan// me tog sil ma phreng ba'i bye brag rnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la= puṣ+pe= gang yang phyogs bcu'i= de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum mchog rin po che// rin chen mar me'i bye brag phreng ba rnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i= ā lo ke= gang yang phyogs bcu'i= de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum mchog na bza' dkar// dri zhim chu gtsang spos dang ldang ba'i chu// rgyal ba skyed pa'i=

gan+dhe= gang yang phyogs bcu'i= rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum mchog phrin las ldan// bza' dang bca' ba la sogs zhal zas rnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi// nai wi d+ya= sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi mdzad pa'i// glu dang rol mo sil snyan bcas pa'i sgra// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan 'phan la sogs// phyogs bcu kun nas sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /shab+da= gsum pa 'dod yon lnga ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos/ bzhes na= shab+da= phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos= bzhes nas= gan+dhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes nas= ra sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes nas= spar+she= bzhi pa sgeg sogs brgyad ni/ oṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni// oṃ badz+ra lā se hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med// oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐/ rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pa// oṃ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye āḥ zhes nang gi lha mo bzhis mchod/ yang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra hāta/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ badz+ra dharma gā ya nī/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra karma ka ro ta bha we/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ zhes phyi'i lha mo bzhi'i mchod pa ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud chog spyi ltar 'bul lo// lnga pa rgyal srid sna bdun ni/

zhing 'dir 'khor lo rin chen gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir// nyin re shes rab can gyis dbul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhing 'dir nor bu rin chen gyis/ mkhas pa dag gis= dngos grub 'dod pa= nyin re shes rab= ma ṇi= zhing 'dir btsun mo= mkhas pa dag gis= dngos grub 'dod pa= nyin re shes rab= was+t+rī= zhing 'dir blon po= mkhas pa dag gis= dngos grub 'dod pa= nyin re shes rab= mahā ta= zhing 'dir glang po= mkhas pa dag gis= dngos grub 'dod pa= nyin re shes rab= hasti/ zhing 'dir rta mchog= mkhas pa dag gis= dngos grub 'dod pa= nyin re shes rab= tu raṃ ga= zhing 'dir dmag dpon/ mkhas pa dag gis= dngos grub 'dod pa= nyin re shes rab= khaḍ+ga= zhes sam/ bsdu na/ gser gyi 'khor lo nor bu rin po che// btsun mo khyim bdag glang po rta mchog dang*// g.yul las rgyal byed dmag dpon rin chen te// rgyal srid rin chen bdun yang dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ sap+ta rat+na pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ drug pa bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo ni// phyag na gdugs bzang gser gyi yu ba can// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod pa ltar// dbu la gdugs kyi mchod pa dbul bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ maṅga la tshā traṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i= phyag na gser gyi nya mo 'od 'bar ba// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i spyan la= spyan la gser nya'i mchod pa= mat+s+ya= bkra shis gang zhig= phyag na pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad pa// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i ljags la= ljags la pad+ma'i= pad+ma= bkra shis gang zhig= phyag na rin chen bum pa rab mdzes pa// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i mgul la= mgul la bum pa'i= kum+bha=

bkra shis gang zhig= phyag na dpal gyi be'u rab 'bar ba// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i thugs la= thugs la dpal be'u'i= pat+sa= bkra shis gang zhig= phyag na rin chen rgyal mtshan rab mdzes pa// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i sku la= sku la rgyal mtshan= dh+wa dza= bkra shis gang zhig= phyag na chos kyi dung sgra sgrogs mdzad pa// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i gsung la= gsung la dung gi= shaṃ kha= bkra shis gang zhig= phyag na gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa// bsnams nas rgyal ba'i zhabs la= zhabs la 'khor lo'i= tsakra= zhes sam/ rin chen gdugs dang pad+ma gser nya dung*// bum pa dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo ste// lha yi dga' tshal mdzes par byed pa yi// bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams ni dbul bar bgyi// oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la he tu pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bdun pa bkra shis rdzas brgyad ni/ tshe mchog 'phel byed bdud rtsi sman gi rtswa// dūr ba sngo ljang myu gu'i phreng ba can// yid bzhin 'khor lo sras dang bcas la 'bul// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang thob par shog /oṃ ār+yā tā ra sa pa ri bā re bh+yaḥmaṅga la dūr ba pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ des 'gres te/ dri med shin tu dwangs pa bzhin gyi snod// snod bcud dge mtshan ri mo gsal la rdzogs// yid bzhin 'khor lo= ji lta ji snyed mkhyen nyid myur thob shog /sngags sngar ltar la// maṅga la ā dar+sha= mtshal chen chu las skyes pa'i sin+dhū ra// srid gsum brtan pa 'phrog pa'i dmar 'od can// yid bzhin 'khor lo= snang sems mtha' dag rang dbang 'du bar shog /maṅga la sin+dhū ra= rgyu chung 'phel che ngo mtshar ljon pa'i 'bras// yid 'ong bilba bkra shis dpal kyi gzugs// yid bzhin 'khor lo= chos ldan dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /maṅga la bilba= zug rngu 'joms byed gi waṃ sman gyi mchog /dri ngad ro bcud nus mthu phun sum tshogs// yid bzhin 'khor lo=

rgyu 'bras nad rigs gtan nas spong bar shog /maṅga la go ro tsa na= dkar zlum skye ba lnga ldan g.yas su 'khyil// snyan pa'i sgra yis sa gsum khyab byed pa// yid bzhin 'khor lo= theg chen bla med chos sgra sgrogs par shog /maṅga la shaṅkha= mthong bas bya ba kun la dge legs byed// myang bas lus srog 'tsho ba'i bcud ldan zho// yid bzhin 'khor lo= chags thogs med pa'i blo gros rtsal ldan shog /maṅga la da dhi= bgegs rigs kun 'joms rdo rje khro bo'i mtshon// 'jigs med dpa' bo yungs kar gser gyi mdog /yid bzhin 'khor lo sras dang bcas la 'bul// 'jigs brgyad bdud bzhi 'gal rkyen kun zhi shog /maṅga la sat+pi ta= zhes sam/ me long li khri yungs kar bilba dang*// gi waṃ dung dkar zho mchog dūrba ste// rgyal bas byin rlabs bkra shis rdzas chen brgyad// rje btsun sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// sngags thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la dra bya= sbyar/ brgyad pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu bkod la/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i khor yug oṃ bud+dha badz+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ rnam snang gi zhing gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i ri rab/ oṃ badz+ra badz+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ mi bskyod pa'i zhing gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i lus 'phags/ oṃ rat+na badz+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ rin 'byung gi zhing gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i 'dzam bu gling*/ oṃ pad+ma badz+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ snang mtha'i zhing gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i ba lang spyod/ oṃ karma badz+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ don grub kyi zhing gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i sgra mi snyan/ de dag re re zhing yang bye ba dung phyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa mchod rdzas du mas yongs su gang bas dus rtag tu mchod par gyur/ zhing khams rnam dag rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i ri rab la sogs mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams bsam yas rdo rje'i rgyan phreng 'bar// rdo rje'i maṇ+ḍal bla med bkod pa 'di// rdo rje sgrol ma sangs rgyas kun yum la// mchog tu dad pas kun tu bdag 'bul lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

dgu pa mchod pa sna tshogs pa ni/ dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// ljon pa'i shing dang shing dag gi /dri zhim lo 'dab bcas pa'i shing*// phyogs bcu kun nas gtibs gyur cig /spos kyi dri ngad ldang ba'i char// 'bru dang me tog la sogs pa'i// yid du 'ong ba'i dri zhim char// nges par kun tu 'bab par shog /'bab chu lteng ka lu ma dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu dag dang ni// ro brgya dag dang ldan pa'i mtsho// ngang pa la sogs bcas pa yi// rin chen khang pa yid 'ong ba'i// drwa ba drwa ba phyed pa dang*// shar nub 'od bcas nyi zla dag dang ni// khang pa shin tu yid tu 'ong ba rnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// sngags thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ bi bi dhā naṃ sbyar/ bcu pa bstod pa ni/ seng ge glang chen me sbrul chom rkun dang*// lcags sgrog rgya mtsho sha za'i 'jigs pa rnams// zhi mdzad zla ba'i 'od ltar mdzes pa'i sku// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma gnyis la ni// yan lag mchog gis rab tu gtugs gyur na// mngon 'dod bde ba'i 'bras bu smin mdzad ma// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= /'dab ma brgya ldan yangs pa'i snying po ni// gser zhun nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog 'dra zhing*// rdul bral ston ka'i zla ltar dri med ma// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= /drang srong gtso dang grub pa lto 'phye che// gshin rje srin po gnod sbyin lha min dang*// lha tshogs rnams kyis zhabs la phyag byas pa'i// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= /gling dang nags tshal stug po ri khrod dang*// phug dang chu klung ri bo'i rtse rnams su// dus rnams kun tu bzhugs par gyur pa yi// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= /seng ge stag dang glang po mtsho chen dang*// me dang 'ching ba rkun po sbrul gdug gi /gnod pa thams cad rab tu 'joms mdzad ma// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la=

tā re tut+tā re dang tu re yis// g.yul gyi mtshon cha zlog mdzad phan par dgongs// 'jigs dang rmi lam ngan pa 'joms mdzad ma// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= thugs rjes non pa'i thabs kyis gang dang gang*// sems can gzigs gyur de yi dpal 'phel 'gyur// sgrol mas mi bslu'i 'bras bu myur thob mdzad// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa dang*/ oṃ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa/ gzhan yang phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i mtshon brgya rtsa brgyad pa'ang shes na klog par bya'o// lnga pa ni/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad sogs nas/ de las 'od zer gyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs lha dang mi'i 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rtsi sman rin po che la sogs pa'i nus pa byin rlabs dngos grub mtha' dag 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas spyan drangs/ rang dang mdun bskyed la thim pas 'chi ba med pa tshe la dbang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub thob/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer snod bcud thams cad la phog pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor spang rtogs yon tan mtha' dag rgyas par gyur/ ces pa gtso bo dang*/ nad gdon zhi ba dang*/ srung ba la sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i dmigs pa 'phrul shes pas/ yi ge bcu pa dang*/ tshe spel ba la tshe sham can sogs sham bu btags pa bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi byas la/ thun gyi mjug mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// sogs kyis 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa ni/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan la bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/

lto ba yangs pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgrin pa bcings shing dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang du lnga tshan lnga dang bdud rtsi'i chus yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po sogs nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab par bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid sogs kyi tshig 'byin 'jug mdun bskyed ltar bya'o// mchod pa kha gso/ byin rlabs gong ltar/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don tu bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ shab+da'i bar tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma// dpa' mo tā re tut+tā re// sangs rgyas zhal gyi pad+ma yi// ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud// ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi// dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ma// mchog sbyin phyag rgyas ut+pa la// bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i gzeb las tut+tā re// swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad// oṃ gyis ngo bo nyid kyis ni// tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed ma la 'dud// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad rnams las// 'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad// kun gyi mar gyur bcom ldan 'das// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pas bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa bar ma chad du byung*/ gzungs thag la brgyud de bum lha'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes byin rlabs dang brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad bdud rtsi'i ngo bor spyan drangs bum lha'i thugs kar thim pas/

'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa dang sku'i gnas thams cad las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgyun babs bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs gnad dang ldan pas yig bcu dang sham can bzla/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las dmigs bsal byed na dmigs pa dang sngags kyi sham bu kha bsgyur/ mjug tu mchod bstod dang 'dod gsol nyung bsdus bya/ dung chos kyi chu me tog dang bcas gzungs thag dang ma bral bar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod yon gyi tshul du bum par blugs/ dril bu gsil bzhin yig brgya tshar gsum brjod/ bcom ldan 'das ma thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu zhu ba dam tshig gi bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med par gyur/ bum pa rdo rje'i drwa bas g.yogs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrungs bar bya'o// rjes gnang sogs la phyag rgyun ltar las bum bsgrub na pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo rta mgrin gyi sgom bzlas byas kyang 'brel mod/ 'dir spyi tsam du las bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ las bum gyi dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon g.yas rdo rje'i be con dang g.yon sdigs mdzub can khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngags gang 'grub bzla/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan bdud rtsi'i thal mo legs sbyar bas// byang sems spyi bor gshegs pa'i mthu stobs kyis// bdud bzhi rtsad nas bcad pa'i dgra thabs mkhan// bcom ldan khro bo chen por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'od du zhu bas chu'i rdul phra rab ji snyed pa khro bo'i tshogs su gyur/ ces pa ste/ spros pa bsdu na gong du bsang chu bsgrubs pa nyid kyis 'thus pa yin no// bzhi pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/

ma 'das pa'o// dang po ni/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs nas brtsams phrin las bcol ba'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs su smos pa ltar bya ba las/ gtor mgron spyan 'dren pa 'dir mi dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ cha gsum kun rig las 'byung ba ltar ram/ yang na maṇ+ḍal cho gar bshad pa ltar/ chos skyong*/ gzhi bdag lan chags gtor ma bcas gtang ngo*// skabs 'dir bkru byabs kyi cho ga rjes gnang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs las rab 'byams gang brtsams pa la 'jug pa yin no// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la bdun/ mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ nongs bshags/ bsdu rim/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis so// dang po ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ dkon mchog ta la nas gsungs pa'i mchod tshig mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen mo 'phags ma 'khor bcas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar spel tshig sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// sogs dang*/ thun mtshams kyi bya bar smos pa'i gsol gdab gang rung skabs dang 'brel bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po rnams lan gsum mam bdun brjod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// bdag cag las dang po pa'i gang zag bsam pa nyon mongs pa can gyi bying rgod dbang du gyur nas ting nge 'dzin ma gsal ba dang*/ yo byad ma tshang zhing mchod tshogs nyung la gtsang sbras ma phyed pa dang*/

sngags ma dag cing cho ga lhag chad nor 'khrul sogs nongs pa'i las ci mchis pa thams cad 'phags ma thugs rje ldan pa khyed rnams la bzod par gsol na 'phral yun sgrib par mi 'gyur ba dag tshangs su dbugs dbyung zhing las dang dngos grub thogs pa med pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ bzhi pa ni mchod yon sbreng*/ yig brgya brjod/ mdun bum gyi ye shes pa rten yod na brtan bzhugs spyi mthun bya/ rten med na/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyis gshegs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa// sogs kyis 'jig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs/ a kā ros rdul tshon mtha' nas dbus su bsdu/ lha mtshan cung zad rang gi spyi bor bkod par bya'o// lnga pa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur sogs rgyas bsdus gang 'thad brjod/ drug pa smon lam ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// dge 'dun bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis// thog med 'khor ba chen po nas// sbyin dang tshul khrims sgom pa yi// dge bgyis bgyid stsal rjes yi rang*// de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba yi// sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi ni// rgyan dang yo byad rnal 'byor gyi// tshogs su gyur te pha ma dang*// mkhan po slob dpon la sogs kyi// ched du sangs rgyas thob par shog /ma thob bar du bdag dge 'dis// theg chen bla ma mchog bsten nas// sdom gsum gnas pa'i lus bzung zhing*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub ste// phan tshun sdig pa mi sog shog /'dir yang dge 'byung bsod nams kyis// tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dang*// 'khor dang dge sbyor la sogs pa'i// phun sum tshogs pa kun gyis 'byor// bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog /ces rje btsun mi la la sgrol mas dngos su gsungs pa'i smon lam gdab/

bdun pa bkra shis ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod sngon tu 'gro bas/ rgyal mchog tshe dpag med pa'i yum// 'chi med nges par ster ba mo// rig pa 'dzin ma bcom ldan 'das// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog /gang la rgyal kun gus btud de// phyag 'tshal thal sbyar rab bstod pa// lha rnams kun gyi lhar gyur pa// bcom ldan sgrol ma'i bkra shis shog /bdag dang skye dgu thams cad pa// 'jigs pa kun las rab sgrol zhing*// phan dang bde ba rab 'phel ma// 'dod don kun 'grub bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ gzhan yang 'brel chags pa'i shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// //lnga pa sbyin sreg gi cho ga la gsum/ bya ba'i dus/ byas pa'i dgos pa/ lag len dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na bsnyen sgrub zin pa'i rjes thog de nyid du bya zhing*/ nad gdon zhi ba dang*/ tshe bsod spel ba sogs las bye brag pa sgrub na zhi ba mar ngo dang*/ rgyas pa yar ngo sogs so so'i dus skabs su babs pa'i tshe bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las/ sna tshogs las ni rab bsgrub phyir// sbyin sreg las ni bshad par bya// de ni lha yi kha ru gsungs// sbyin sreg de ni rnam par gnas// sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshims// tshims nas dngos grub rab tu stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /sbyin sreg gis ni de kun dgang*// zhes pas cho ga dang sngags kyi lhag chad kha skong ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu myur du ster bar byed pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa'o// de'ang kha skong la zhi ba gtsor byed pa yin zhing*/ las so so la so so'i cho ga dang rdzas kyi bum bskyed pa'ang shes par bya'o// dang po la gsum/ thab/ yo byad/ cho ga'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ sbyin sreg gang du bya ba'i sar phyin la/ bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/
