hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags lan bdun brjod/ sngon gtor btang*/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas de nyid du byed pa yin na 'di mi dgos so// gtsang ma'i sa la stegs bu zlum po tsan+dan dkar po la sogs pas byugs par/ tshangs thig zur thig brgyad po gdab/ dbus nas thig skud mtho gang gis zlum por bskor ba thab/ de rgyab sor bzhi pa gnyis bskor ba mu ran dang kha khyer lte ba nas mu ran gyi mtha'i tshad nyis 'gyur gyis zur thig steng bya rjes btab pa'i steng nas phyogs bzhir gru bzhir bcad/ de rgyab sor gnyis bsnan nas bcad pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ mu ran la ze'u 'bru/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ pad+ma'i lte bar ut+pal rdo rjes mtshan pa sor brgyad pa rnams bri/ de dag gi gzhi dkar po la ma 'dres pa'i tshon gyis re khā bcad/ zlum thig nang ma'i nang nas dri zhim po'i bud shing gis zlum por brtsig me tshang ngam ting lo bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi g.yon tu mchod yon gyi snod che chung gnyis/ bsang gtor gyi snod gcig nyer spyod lnga/ zlum gtor dkar po che chung gnyis/ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab sogs bzhag g.yas su mar khu dang yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams rim can tu bsgrigs pa dang me lha la thams cad phyogs su bsdus pa tsho gcig 'jig rten 'das pa la rdzas spungs grangs gsog 'bul na snod che bar phyogs su bsres pa bcas bsham/ gzhan yang sdig pa zhi pa'i ched du til nag nad zhi ba la gro sogs dmigs bsal grangs gsog dgos na de dang de la 'os pa bum pa skyed la bzhag rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol de dang rang gi bar du dril bu/ de'i mdun tu rdo rje/ de gnyis bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar/ ku sha'i chun po'ang gang bder bzhag 'dug stangs chas gos bsam pa sogs spyi ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/

sgrub mchod sogs dang 'brel na bdag mdun las bum sgrub pa sogs sngon tu btang*/ de dag dang ma 'brel ba dus gang yang rung bar sbyin sreg kho na byed na/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldang gi bar sngon tu song nas mdun bskyed skabs ltar bsang chu byin brlab/ las bum yod pa'i rigs yin na bsang chu zur du mi dgos/ de nas oṃ badz+ra a mṛ twa sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod bzhin bsang chus gnas khang yo byad kun la gtor/ mdun bskyed ltar mchod pa byin brlab/ bsreg rdzas rnams la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya gtad nas/ oṃ swā hā lan gsum gyis ma dag pa bkrus par bsam/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ gsum gyis yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā gsum gyis zhun mar dang*/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā gsum gyis 'bru thams cad dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ gsum gyis rdzas gzhan rnams byin brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis me blang*/ sgron me sbar/ a mṛ tas de la bsang chu gtor/ a mṛ ta bzla bzhin tu thab la g.yas skor bya/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes me sgron thab nang du gzhug hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis me sbar ro// thab khung a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po khru gang ba/ mu ran dang kha khyer gyis bskor zhing*/ stegs bu'i gra la zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbyibs can/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ de'i nang du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zhi ba'i me lha dkar po/ phyag g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ me lce dkar po'i phreng ba dkrigs shing*/ ra skyes dkar po'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa'o// rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya las mthe bong rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhed slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sā dha ka ma hā bhū ta/ de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza sa twāṃ/ gṛ hī twā ā hu tiṃ ā ha ra asmin san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes spyan drang*/ bsang chu gtor zhing*/ a mṛ tas bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ku sha'i rtse mo g.yas phyogs su bstan nas thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// 'dis bdag gi bgegs zhi zhing mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis bsang gtor byed pa dang lhan cig tu/ mchod yon gyi snod chung ba nas bzed zhal du blugs te/ oṃ āḥhrī pra wa ra sat+ka rā r+thaṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis nyer spyod phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ oṃ badz+ra ā na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba bha smin ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag de nas me lha'i thugs kar hūm̐/ ljags la rdo rje rtse gcig pa ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ dgang blugs kyi kha la'ang hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye/ ā dī bya ā dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha

/ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya bah+nā ya/ bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad nad gdon dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dgang blugs 'bul/ de bzhin tu sngags de nyid kyis yam shing lan gsum phul/ slar yang sngags de nyid lan ji ltar 'os pas/ bsreg rdzas thams cad bsres pa ji ltar rigs par 'bul lo// oṃ ag+nā ye swā hā/ zhes pas mar blugs gzar gang thab tu phul/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// slar yang bsang sbyang*/ me lha'i thugs ka rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ bh+rūṃ las zla ba chu shel gyi gzhal yas khang sogs nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ'i bar mdun bskyed skabs ji lta ba la/ gal te dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na slob dpon nam las slob dkyil 'khor gyi drung du yig brgya brjod bzhin pas mchod yon sbreng*/ spos phor 'dzin pas/ rten ni rdul tshon dkyil 'khor la// bzhugs pa'i brten pa dkyil 'khor pa// thab kyi dbus kyi dkyil 'khor du// deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhes snyan gsan dbab ste/ snying po brjod bzhin pas me tog lha'i ngo bor mos te rdul tshon nas len pa'i tshul gyis rin po che'i snod du blangs shing bkur sti dang bcas sbyin sreg khang par spyan drangs te/ oṃ thugs rje rmad byung sogs gzhung ltar la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i skabs su me tog thab tu dor la dbang bskur rgyas gdab par bya'o// de nas mchod yon gyi snod gnyis pa nas ku shas bsang gtor 'bul bzhin tu bzed zhal du blug yi ge bcu pa'i mthar gong gi mchod yon gyi sngags sbyar bas mchod yon 'bul/ me tog nas rol mo'i bar dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol lta bus bstod/ spros pa la dga' na mdun bskyed skabs su 'byung ba'i mchod bstod rgyas pa sbyar/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal/

bcom ldan 'das ma'i ljags la yang*// tām̐ yig dag gis mtshan pa yis// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsis bzhes par gyur// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes pa lan gcig oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun/ bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad nad gdon dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa lan gcig spel bas mtshon/ bsreg rdzas so sor grangs ka ji tsam 'bul yang des 'gres shes par bya ste/ de ni mar khu'i sngags so// de bzhin tu/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ yam shing gi sngags so// oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ til dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras ma grus pa dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho zan dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ ku sha dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mahā be gā ya swā hā/ nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mahā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai swā hā/ gro dang*/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dhā ya swā hā/ yungs kar gyi sngags so// gzhan yang zas sna sman 'bru rin chen dar zab sogs mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pas mchod par bya ste/ snying po'i sngags kyis 'bul bar bya'o// de la mar dang yam shing ni med du mi rung ba yin la/ rdzas gzhan de dag ji tsam rnyed pa de tsam 'bul ba yin kyang*/ las thams cad pa la lta ci smos/ zhi ba rkyang pa la'ang rdzas de dag 'dzoms na legs shing*/ rab gnas dang rang gzhan gyi zhi ba'i las spyi 'gro tsam bsgrub pa la/ bsreg rdzas so sor re nas brgya phrag re re tsam dang*/ rdzas sngags kyang de tsam 'phul ba yin la/ tshe'i bar chad kho na zhi bar byed pa sogs/ zhi ba'i las nye tshe ba la/ so so'i rdzas dang sngags sna re re de kho na byed pa sogs yod kyang*/ dngos grub kyi don dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong la thog mar mar khu/

yam shing mang tsam dang*/ lhag ma bsreg rdzas so so la grangs mnyam pa mang nyung gang 'os re phul ba'i rjes su rdzas spungs rnams snying po'i sngags kho nas sreg par byed pa nyid la ji tsam dgos pa'i grangs 'dzin pa nyid bzang ba yin no// bsreg rdzas rdzogs pa'i mthar mdun bskyed skabs ltar gtor 'bul/ mchod bstod/ zhi ba'i 'dod gsol gang 'os bya/ yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de ring bzod mdzad rigs// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs// bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol lags// ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsal// sems can kun la ci 'dod par// dngos grub bla na med pa'ang stsal// slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir// rang gi gnas gshegs badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba'am/ gnyis kar yang rang gi snying gar bsdu ba skabs su gang bab sbyar ro// gal te sngon tu tshom bu spyan drangs yod na skabs 'dir/ slob dpon gyis yig bcu brjod bzhin me tog thab dbus nas len pa'i tshul gyis spyan 'dren pa'i skabs ltar khyer la dkyil 'khor du bzhugs su gsol te/ yig bcu'i mthar badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dang*/ rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor la// spyan drangs dkyil 'khor thim par gyur// ces mos te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// de nas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pas mar blugs gzar gang phul/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod pa gong bzhin/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghun+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/

me lha'i gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya nas/ bah+na ya la/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs sbyar la lan bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/ yang ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las bcol/ gong bzhin mchod yon phul/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yi// sogs bzod par gsol/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon cing*// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i me'i ngang du thim par gyur/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya/ me rang bzhin gyis zhi bar ma gyur gyi bar du dkrug par mi bya la/ glo bur du las rjes bsdu dgos pa byung na/ 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chu la/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa tsam bzlas te me la blug go /gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi/ thab kyi gzhi ser po la re khā ma 'dres pas bcad cing*/ lte bar ut+pal rin po ches mtshan pa 'bri ba dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo tshe 'phel ba la dūr+wa/ bsod nams rgyas pa la 'bras so ba la sogs bung bskyed/ 'dug stangs chas gos sogs bsgyur/ 'don bya'i skabs su'ang zlum po la gru bzhi/ dkar po la ser po sogs dang*/ bsreg rdzas 'dod gsol skabs bdag gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags mnga' thang spang rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

zhes bsgyur ba tsam las gzhan zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sor bzhag nyid kyis 'thus la/ spyir phyag len gyi babs sogs sbyin sreg spyi'i go ba chags shing khog khrol ba zhig ci nas gal che/ 'di las spros pa rgyas pa 'dod na rje dgu pas mdzad pa'i yig cha la sogs pa ltar ram/ lugs rnying sor bzhag spro na gtsang pa blo bzang pa'i yig cha la rje pad+ma dkar pos lhan thabs su spros pa nyid 'dus shing gsal bas de ltar bya'o// drug pa las la sbyor ba la/ sdom ni/ 'khor lo srung 'khor 'jigs dang sdang*// lam dgra jag rkun dug dang mdze// 'bogs pa'i nad dang mtshon cha srung*// btson 'don 'thab rgyal mig nad bsal// ngag 'grol nad gsol bar chad sel// khrus chog rmis brtag dbang gi las// srid spel bder btsa' byis pa gso// nor dang blo gros tshe spel ba'o// de'ang rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo'i bsnyen sgrub sbyin sreg bcas grangs dus rtags gsum gyis sgrub pa po nus pa thob pa'am/ tha na'ang rtsa ba'i sngags yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa bye ba sngon tu song ba'i gang zag gis las so so la sngags dang dmigs pa'i gnad cung zad kha bsgyur bas phrin las brtsams pa 'grub ste/ 'phags pa klus/ rang gi las dang mthun pa yi// sgrol ma yi ni ting 'dzin gyis// las gzhan dag kyang bya bar nus// zhes gsung so// de la dang po gdags pa'i 'khor lo ni/ dar ras gtsang mar skyes pa la gur gum/ bud med la gi waṃ gis 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐/ de mthar srung ba yin na/ oṃ che ge mo la nad gdon 'jigs brgyad dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rak+ṣa hā/ lta bu dang*/ rgyas pa'i las yin na/ oṃ che ge mo'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags nyams rtogs la sogs pa puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hā/ lta bu kha bsgyur rig pas 'phrul/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas g.yas skor du/

tā/ re/ tutā/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā/ de rgyab mu khyud bdun bskor ba'i dang po la ye dhar/ gnyis par rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.ā hā che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gsum par dbyangs gsal/ bzhi par bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs ring*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha bh+yo/ na mo mahā badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭa bhe ra bā ye/ badz+ra san+toha dar+pā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ lnga pa ral gri rtse mo phyir bstan tām̐ gis mtshan pa/ drug pa la hūm̐ yig sha stag bdun par me ri bcas bris nas rang sngags dang ye dhar gyis rab tu gnas/ rin po che'i snod du zhag bdun sogs lhar bskyed la sgrub cing mchod/ sgrol ma zhu nas tām̐ yig tu gyur par mos la dril te rin po che'i snod du bcug skyes pa'i g.yas dang bud med kyi g.yon nas gnyis ka'i mgul du btags/ phan yon ni gsham du 'byung ngo*// srung ba la 'khor lo ljang gu dang che spel ba la dkar po gtso bo yin mod kyi dkar pos kyang thams cad 'grub bo// yang yig rnying ltar na mu khyud rim bzhi'i lte bar oṃ gyen bstan/ hā thur bstan/ de gnyis bar du 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru/ rtsibs brgyad la yig 'bru brgyad/ rtsibs mchan la dbyangs bcu drug gnyis re/ de rgyab pad dkar/ de rgyab rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor ba bri/ maṇ+ḍal steng bum pa'i khar bzhag tsakra chu bo chen po'i steng du bzhugs par bsam/ mdun bskyed ltar bsgrubs la rab tu gnas te gdag go /'khor lo 'di dag gis bcings pa dgrol ba/ blo 'phel/ dbang sdud sogs kha sgyur ji ltar 'os pa 'grub par gsal te/ 'phags pa klus/ sbyor ba de yis rgyal po yi// btson ra la sogs bsrung bar bya// sgrol ma'i las kyi sbyor ba las// las rnams yang dag bsgrub bya ste// nad sogs zhi ba'i las dang ni// dbang du bya ba'i sbyor ba la'ang*// cho ga gong ma de nyid las// 'khor lo la sogs kha dog dang*// sngags kyi spel ba bstan par bya// zhes dang*/

bsgrub bya shes rab zhen pa dang*// le lo can sogs rnams la ni// gong ma'i cho ga de nyid las// gzhan tu bya bar bstan pa ste// 'khor lo snga ma de nyid las// sngags rnams g.yon bskor dag tu 'god// mu khyud la yang a sogs 'god// de ltar bsgom dang bzlas byas na// blo dman rnams ni blo ldan 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gro ga la sogs gzhi la ni// 'khor lo gong ma ltar bris nas// lus la bcangs par byas na yang*// de tsam gyis kyang bsrung bar 'gyur// zhes sogs rgyas par 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa chag che ba la 'khor lo'i gur khang gis srung ba ni/ mtshan bcas rdzogs rim skabs ltar la 'od khyim rim pa drug mi dgos/ 'khor lo'i rgyab tu rdo rje dang me ri dkar po'i gur khang bsgom pa gsung rgyun las 'byung*/ bsrung bya gzhan yod na'ang gur khang nang du sgrol ma'i skur gyur nas chud par bsgoms la/ yig brgyad gsham du/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ lta bu 'jigs pa gang yin de'i ming nas smos pa'i spel tshig sbyar/ shin tu zab/ yang grub chen karma pa'i gdams ngag sgrol dkar lha lnga las 'byung ba ltar na pad nyi zla gdan la tām̐/ de las bh+rūm̐ chad pas/ gur thabs kyi 'khor lo phyi mtshon cha/ nang gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus su rang nyid tām̐ las sgrol ma dkar mo thugs kar 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ rtsibs brgyad la sgrol ma khro gnyer can dkar mo brgyad/ g.yas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ g.yon sdigs mdzub lcags kyu/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs stag sham can/ khro mo'i rnam gyur yongs su rdzogs pa/ sku la bskal me 'bar bas byad ma gnod byed sreg pa/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs nam mkhar bzhugs pa la yan lag bdun pa dang pū dza phul/ gsol ba gdab pas bdag dang bsrung bya la yang yang thim pas byin gyis brlabs/ gur khang g.yas su 'khor ba'i rtsibs rtses byad ma gnod byed gtubs/

mtshon cha dang me rlung 'tshubs mas gnod byed skad cig la rdul phran bzhin brlag par bsam/ bzlas pa byed 'dod na thugs ka'i tām̐ la sngags kyis g.yon tu bskor/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams sgrol ma zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis gang nas srung bar bsgoms la/ yig brgyad gsham du/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa srungs shig swā hā/ zhes bzla/ zlog pa byed na/ 'jig rten khams rnams sgrol ma zhi khros gang*/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis gnod byed tshar bcad par mos/ sngags gsham/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog swā hā/ zhes btags/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i srung ba rdo rje'i go cha snyan brgyud thugs la gab pa yin gsungs// //gsum pa dgra dang gcan gzan sbrul la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa spyi srung ba ni/ rang gi gos kyi mtha' 'am ska rags sam skra'i steng du zla ba la tām̐ dkar po/ de'i 'od kyis gnod byed bkug ste bcings par bsam/ rtsa sngags la rak+ṣa btags pa lan bdun brjod cing dbugs bsdoms la mdud pa gsum bor/ 'jigs pa las thar nas bkrol/ yang tho rangs maṇ+ḍal du yan lag bzhi rdzogs bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma yan lag bdun pa byas pas phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i rgyas rang gi spyi bor reg par bsams la dngos su phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs pas 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyob cing btson las kyang thar gsungs/ 'jigs brgyad so sor srung ba'i bsgom bzlas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du 'byung yang zhib par na phyag brgyad sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel zhing*/ spyi tsam du rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa'i las tshogs su sbyor du rung bas spro na gzhan tu shes par bya'o// yang bu mo mgo gtsang gis srung skud dkar po ring po zhig byas pa bsang sbyang*/ mdud pa nyer gcig byas la re re bzhin sgrol mar bsgom/ yig brgyad gsham du/ 'di 'chad pa la chom rkun dang gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/

lta bu spel tshig bsgyur ba brgya stong ci nus bzla/ lha bstim/ rten snying gis rab gnas byas pa bsrung bya la btags pas srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// yang 'og tu srid spel skabs su smos pa'i tā ri ṇi'i sngags bris te rke'am dpung bar btags pas kyang 'jigs pa thams cad las srung bar byed do// bzhi pa rang la sdang ba bcing na/ so phag la yung ba'i khu bas yi ge lam̐ chen po 'bri/ de'i khog par/ oṃ bha hā li bha rā li ba ra ha mu kha si dā du taṃ na du sha ni mu khi/ che ge mo s+t+wam+bha ya swā hā/ zhes bri/ sgrol ma'i nga rgyal gyis rtsa sngags dang*/ sngags 'di'ang bzlas la lam rgya gram gyi 'og tu mnan pas sdang byed thams cad 'ching bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa lam dgra srung ba ni/ dar ram shog bu la ce spyang gi gzugs sngags bcas dpe'u chung ltar bkod/ de nas dben pa'i gnas su rin po che'i snod du gzhug mchod pa lnga bsham// gtor ma zhig kyang bsham/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu sangs rgyas thob par bya/ khyad par du bdag gi byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung*/ de'i ched du 'di bya snyam du bsams la/ de nas mdun gyi gzugs brnyan de mi dmigs pa las sgrol ma'i sprul pa ste/ ngo bo rje btsun ma la rnam pa ce spyang sngon mor bsams la/ rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'dir bskyed pa kho na dang 'dra ba zhig spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod la dgug gzhug bcing*/ dgyes pa bskyed/ mchod pa lnga 'bul/ gsol ba btab/ de nas/ oṃ sū mi su ma badh+ya dhe ma swā hā/ zhes khri la sogs pa bzla/ rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i nas 'bru gzugs la gtor/ gtor sngags ba lin+ta dang kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la ce spyang la phul nas gsol ba btab/ de nas legs par dril te srung ba lus la btags/

lam du 'gro dus mdun tu ce spyang wal gyis bskyed la ye shes pa bstim/ dpal bi ma de ba'i ce spyang sngon mo la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas rang gi gom pa bdun bor sna drangs nas phyin na nges par 'grub bo// ce spyang sngon mo'i lam srung du grags pa zab/ gzhan yang 'gro ba'i nam mkhar sgrol ma skyabs sbyin mdzad pa'i phyag 'og nas 'gro bar bsams la yig bcu gsham can bzla/ bstod pa bya/ mos gus bcas/ bdag 'jigs pa gang yin pa las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba rtse gcig btab pas 'jigs pa dang mi 'phrad cing don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// chu dang g.yang sa lta bu la 'og nas yar bskyor bar mdzad par bsgom gsungs/ drug pa jag rkun las srung ba ni/ lam du zhugs pa'i tshe lam khar rkang pas mda' gzhu'i gzugs bris la rkang pa gnyis kyis 'gengs pa'i tshul bstan te/ de nyid lcags kyi mdar song nas rang gar 'gro ba der tal gyis song bar bsam/ sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma dha na chom rkun dang mi rgod chings shig swā hā/ oṃ thar ni thar ni ma hā thar ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas na lam gyi 'jigs pa 'byung mi srid do// bdun pa dug srung ba ni/ tshal/ gi waṃ/ dri chu bar ba/ phug pa kha byang bstan gyi gting du khru gang brkos pa'i sa/ tsitra ka btsan dug gla rtsi/ mi'i ro tshan rnams cha mnyam pa'am/ gla sgang pa dang li ga dur rtsa ba/ zas ma zos pa'i be'u'i lci ba rnams yar tshes gsum la sogs gza' tshes dge bar sbyar ba'i ril bu sran ma tsam byas/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag sgrol mar bskyed/ bzlas pa brgya stong bya/ zhu ba las ril bu bdud rtsir bsgom/ bza' ba'i tshe na'ang 'khor lo bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya/ lto stong la lan re btang bas zla re bsrung*/ dug gis zin pa la sman mchog tu 'gyur ro// brgyad pa mdze nad gso srung ni/

gu gul dkar po/ shing dā li'i 'dab ma/ ru rta/ gla rtsi/ btsan dug bcas cha mnyam pa'am/ yang na shu dag dang shing kun sbyar ba'i ril bu la sngags spel tshig can 'bum bzlas pa bza' ba dang*/ rang gi dri chu gla rtsi sbyar ba la'ang sngags 'bum bzlas te gnas lngar srin lag gis byug cing*/ rkang pa la'ang byabs pas mdze nad srung zhing*/ de ltar zla ba drug gi bar du bsten na mdze nad kyis zin pa'ang gso bar 'gyur ro// dgu pa 'bogs nad srung ba ni/ mdze rus/ bya rog mig gser gyi phye ma bcangs shing*/ sngags gsham du/ oṃ sum+bhi ro bha na ye swā hā/ zhes brgya brgya bzlas pas gza' phog pa lta bu'i 'bogs nad srung bar byed do// bcu pa mtshon srung ni yig bcu'i gsham du/ tad+ya thā/ ya ma ba ti dha ba ti dha ba ti/ dha ra kī/ ku lu ru lu me swā hā/ zhes mthing shog la gser gyis bris/ rab gnas tshad ldan byas la dbu zhabs ma log par spyi bor gdags/ g.yul 'gyed pa'i dus su rang rje btsun ma bsgoms la gong gi sngags bzla/ the tshom mi bya ba dam tshig yin no// bcu gcig pa btson las 'don pa ni/ dkyil 'khor khru gang las mi chung ba ba'i lci bas byug par rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus su lcags kyu dzaḥyig gis mtshan pa bri/ mtha' skor du me tog dkar po'i tshom bu lnga bkod/ mchod gtor bshams la bdag mdun sgrub cing mchod bstod gsol gdab spyi dang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig mang du brjod/ bdag bskyed lha mo'i thugs ka'i dzaḥlas lcags kyu spros pas btson 'don par bsams la yig bcu khri'i bsnyen pa song nas/ mtshan thog thag gcig tu smra ba bcad de sngags brgya re la mchod bstod gsol gdab tshar re sbyar bas las la sbyor bar bya'o// yang sgrol ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ yig bcu'i gsham du/ oṃ mo tsa ni mo tsa ya/ mok+ṣa ni mok+ṣa ya/ che ge mo dzī bi ba ra de swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags gro ga la skyes pa la gur gum/

bud med la gi waṃ gis bris te bcings pa'i mgo bo la btags pa'am/ chu la lan bdun bsngags te dus gsum du snyim pa bdun bdun phyogs der gtor bas btson gyi 'ching ba las grol lo// bcings pa rang gis bzla shes na mchog ste rtag tu bzla'o// gong smos kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su'ang 'di sbyar na legs 'dra/ bcu gnyis pa 'thab rtsod las rgyal bar byed na/ bdag bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas/ bum pa gsar pa dri bzang gi chus bkang ba'i nang du/ gro ga la gur gum gyis/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo rang ming sbyar mok+ṣa ya dzī paṃ swā hā/ zhes bris pa spra tshil gyis gtums te bcug bum sgrub gzhung ltar bya/ me tog dang dri bzang pos mchod/ sngags de nyid ci 'grub bzlas pa'i chu 'thung pas 'thab mo dang rtsod pa thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro// bcu gsum pa mig nad bsal ba ni/ na mo bi ga ta rā ga mi tri ya siṃ ha lo tsa ni swā hā/ zhes pa'i bsnyen pa khri phrag sngon tu song nas/ tho rangs la brgya rtsa re bzlas shing sngags chus mig bkrus na rab rib mtha' dag sel lo// yang na/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'o ma la lan bdun bsngags pas bkrus na'ang mig nad sel bar gsungs so// yang na/ 'og tu dbang gi las su smos pa'i pad+ma'i sngags kyis ba dmar skya'i lci thal lam/ dge slong gi thab kyi thal ba la bsngags te mtheb srin gyis bzung ste steng du lta bas mig la byabs pa'i tshul byas te thal ba dor ba'am/ sngags de'i su bha ge phyi ma'i gong du ming sbyar ba brgya dang brgyad rtsig ngos logs su bris pa la yang dang yang du bltas pas mig nad zhi ba dang sngags des nad med pa'i mig la lan mang du bsngags pas g.yon 'gul na mi dge ba'i ltas dang*/ g.yas 'gul na dge ba'i ltas ston pa'ang byed de nges pa nyid do// bcu bzhi pa ngag gi byad 'grol ba ni/

rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mchod pa lnga 'bul/ bdun rnam dag bya/ bdag gi ngag bcings pa dang mnan pa las 'grol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang gi snying gar raṃ las me'i rang bzhin gru gsum dmar po/ mgrin par yi ge na nag po/ lce rtser s+t+waṃ nag por bsam/ yi dam gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer byung rang gi snying gar phog pas dmar lam gyi song*/ na dang s+t+waṃ gnyis thul gyis tshig par bsam/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re bhā ga wa tī dzi h+na bā ka ban+dha mo tsa ni swā hā/ sngags stong phrag brgyad bzlas pas lce rdo rje dkar po rtse lngas 'bar ba mthu dang ldan par gyur/ yi dam rang la thim par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwā saṃ rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas lce mthu dang ldan te cis kyang mi tshugs so// bco lnga pa nad gdon bsal ba ni/ rang gi don byed na/ sgrol dkar spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la gus pa chen po la yan lag bdun pa/ bstod pa/ gsol gdab bya/ sngags gsham/ bdag gi nad gdon thams cad shān+tīṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam nad gdon dmigs bsal kha bsgyur gang 'os byas pa ci nus bzla zhing*/ 'phags ma'i sku las bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar po'i rgyun chi li li babs rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bkrus nas lus shel gong ltar gyur/ mthar gsol ba gdab pas 'od zhu rang la thim par mos/ gzhan la byed na rang sgrol dkar du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis sgrol ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sgrol dkar phyag na bum pa thogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nad pa'i steng thod du bzhugs par mos la bstod gsol sngags bzlas sngar ltar la/ bum chus nad gdon bkrus par bsgom/ mthar de rnams nad pa la bstim/ dmigs pa gsal na thun gcig gis nad las grol ba mang gsungs/ yang na rang mdun zla ba'i steng du bsrung bya gnas par bsam/

dmigs bzlas gzhan sngar ltar la/ mthar bsrung bya la lha thim pas sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa'ang mos te snga phyi gnyis la zab khyad cung zad yod do// bcu drug pa bar chad zhi bar byed pa ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i gdams ngag ni/ rang gzhan la 'dre'i cho 'phrul sogs glo bur ba byung na/ rang sgrol ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros/ gnod byed yi dwags sam bar du gcod pa de mdun tu bkug rang gi 'od zer gyis sgrol ma dkar mor bsgyur/ ye shes pa bcug rang gi thugs las spros pa'i mchod pa rnam lngas mchod pas mnyes/ sgrol ma dkar mo khyed kyis bdag gi nad dam gdon nam bar chad che ge mo zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs la bsngo smon byas pas bar chad gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed pa'i steng du slar grogs su 'gyur gsungs/ bcu bdun pa khrus kyi cho ga ni/ rgyas par byed na bdag mdun bum pa gong smos ltar bsgrub/ gtor ma 'bul/ sbyor ba sngon tu btang*/ bsdu na bdag bskyed dang bum pa bsgrubs zin nas bkru byabs srung gsum gyi cho ga spyi dang 'dra bar byas pas byin rlabs mchog tu che'o// grub chen pak+ṣi'i gdams par gzungs chog spyi dang 'dra ba las yig bcu'i gsham du/ spyan ma'i sngags dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad e ho shud+dhe sogs khrus bdun gyi rig pa bzla bar gsungs so// bco brgyad pa rmi lam brtag pa ni/ sngon tu rang yi dam du bsgoms la mngon par rtogs pa tshar gcig legs par bya/ de'i ngang nas bdag nyid sgrol ma dkar mor krong gis bskyed/ snying ga'i pad+ma kha bye ba'i lte ba la/ yi ge tām̐ dkar po las 'od 'bar bas lus kyi nang khong stong du 'dug pa mer gyis gang bar bsam mo// tām̐ yig gi phyogs bzhir dngul gyi me long bzhi la a nu ta ra/ zhes pa shar/ lho/ nub/ byang gi me long bzhi la rim par gzugs brnyan ltar bsam/

tām̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas sgrol ma spyan drangs la bstim/ rten 'brel mngon shes su 'char ba'i gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo// de nas rang gi don gang yin pa tām̐ dkar po zhig tu bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal khams kyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byas shing*/ khyad par rang gi don gang yin pa byas nas tām̐ gi 'od zer skar mda' lta bu byung ba bdag gi smin mtshams su zug par bsam/ dngos grub de zhu ba'i 'dun pa drag pos tām̐ de khyur mid byas par bsam/ de nas snying ga'i tām̐ la thim pas/ gang 'dod pa de rmi lam du the tshom med par 'char bar bsam mo// de nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis gnyid log shar gyi me long la a yod pas/ as mtshon pa'i ming gi snang ba gang byung tshad don mi 'grub par bstan to// lho'i me long la nu yod pas/ nu'i ming yig gis mtshon pa'i snang tshad don 'grub par bstan to// nub kyi me long la ta yod pas/ ta'i yi ges mtshon pa'i snang ba byung na mi mtshon pa'i rnam par shar ba thams cad mi 'grub par bstan pa yin no// mtshon pa'i gzugs su snang ba byung tshad ni 'grub par bstan pa yin no// byang gi me long la ra yod pas/ des mtshon pa'i ming yig snang ba byung na/ srog chags kyi snang ba shar tshad don 'grub par bstan pa yin no// srog chags ma yin pa'i gzugs su shar tshad ni don mi 'grub par bstan pa yin no// rje btsun ma la gtang rag gi mchod pa 'bul lo// rten 'brel mngon sum du 'char ba'i gdams ngag go /zhes bshad do// bcu dgu pa dbang gi las ni/ rang la mi dad cing sdang sems su lta ba yod na bya ste/ sems bskyed mchod pa sngon tu song nas/ rang rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo/ smin mtshams su pad+ma dmar por tām̐ la yi ge bcu pas bskor bar mos la bzlas pa byas pas/ de las 'od 'phros mi gus pa de la phog pas mdun tu bkug

de'ang rje btsun ma dmar mo smin mtshams sngags yod pa zhig tu bsgom/ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag de ltar yang yang byas pas gus shing dad par 'gyur ro// oṃ pad+me pad+mā k+ṣi pad+ma su bha gi phuḥ pad+me pad+me/ ak+ṣe pad+ma/ su bha ge phuḥswā hā/ sngags 'dis lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i mig gis bltas pas mthong ma thag tu khros pa zhi nas rab tu dad par 'gyur/ lan bdun bsngags pa'i chus gdong bkrus na skye bo thams cad dga' bar byed do// na mo bha ga ba te/ uṣ+ṇī ṣā ya dha re dha ran+ti ye swā hā/ sngags 'di gi waṃ la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas dpral bar thig le byas na gang la bltas pa thams cad dga' bar 'gyur/ mig rtsi la brgya rtsa bzlas nas mig la byugs pas kyang de bzhin no// chu khyor gang la lan bdun bzlas te 'thung na zas rnyed/ gos kyi mtha' la lag pa g.yon pas bzung la lan nyer gcig bzlas te tshogs pa'i nang du phyin pas tshig btsan par 'gyur ba sogs yon tan mang ngo*// nyi shu pa srid 'phel bar byed pa ni/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ gi waṃ/ yung ba/ gla rtsi gsum bsres pa'i khu bas shog bu'am gro ga la yig bcu dang 'og gi gzungs sngags bris la bum pa'i kha rgyan gseb tu gdags/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang*/ bo dhi tse mig ma phug pa rdog po 'ga' zhib par btags pa ba dmar gyi 'o ma dang mar bsres nas blug mgul chings gzungs rdor kha rgyan dang bcas pa bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ bum sgrub gong smos ltar la khyad par thun 'jog khar lag pa g.yas pas bum pa'i kha bkab nas/ oṃ tā ra ni/ tā ra ya/ oṃ mo tsa ni/ mo tsa ya/ oṃ mok+ṣa ni mok+ṣa ya/ dzī baṃ ba ra de swā hā/ zhes brgya phrag tsam bzlas nas mchod bstod bya/ bum lha zhu ba bum pa'i chur bsam/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul/ 'dod don 'grub par gsol ba btab/ de'ang thun bzhir bcad pa'i zhag bdun tsam bya/

de nas bum chu de bud med dus kyi zla mtshan chad nas zhag gsum lon pa la blud cing khrus byas na mo gsham la'ang bu skye'o// nyer gcig pa sbrum ma bde bar btsa' ba ni/ gong gi sngags gdags pa'i bum par dri bzang gi chu dang nyer lnga'i rdzas sbyar ba blug mchod cing gsol ba btab/ bum sgrub gong ltar byas la nyin thog thag oṃ tā re swā hā/ zhes gtso bor bzla/ mtshan mor yig bcu bzla/ skabs su/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re che ge mo mok+ṣa ya dzī baṃ swā hā/ zhes brgya stong bzlas pas bum chu sngags la/ nam phyed yol gyi dus su sbrum ma ku sha'i gdan la bzhag bgegs sbyong ba sogs sngon du 'gro bas kha shar du bltas la khrus bya zhing blud/ mar la sngags pas sbrum ma'i lus dang bha ga la byugs na na tsha med par bde bar btsa'o// nyer gnyis pa byis pa gso ba ni/ ma btsas par ma dang bcas nas bu la sgrol ma'i srung 'khor gdags/ skyes ma thag pa dang grub na nyin re bzhin ma bu gnyis la bsgrubs pa'i bum chu blud cing bkru byabs srung gsum bya/ rje btsun ma la maṇ+ḍal gyi cho gas mchod cing gsol ba gdab/ bgegs dang 'byung po la gtor ma btang*/ bu ram ma nu gnyis ril ma tsam re/ rgya tshwa nas tsam/ gla ba sran ma tsam bcas nu zho dang sbar nas byis pa la byin pas nges par 'tsho'o// grub chen pak+ṣi'i gdams pa las/ bu tsha'i ma sgrol mar bsgom/ ma bu gnyis kyi sgo gsum la ye shes pa yang yang bstim/ gzungs chu chad med blud/ srung 'khor rtag tu bsgom/ tshe ril lus la byugs shing mgul tu btags/ skye ba'i dus su rin po che sna bdun tshon skud sna lnga dam rdzas la byin rlabs byas pa dang srung 'khor gdags par gsungs so// nyer gsum pa nor spel ba ni/ sems bskyed/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ sgrol ma dkar mo gnas 'gyur gser can sgron ma ser mo g.yas rin po che'i bum pa/

g.yon snye ma 'dzin par bsam// oṃ dzam+bhe mo he swā hā/ zhes pa de la bsnyen pa 'bum tsho bdun bskyar/ las la sbyor tsa na jo mo'i sku rab gnas byas pa zhig mdun tu dgram/ kha lho phyogs su bltas la mchod pa lnga bsham/ me tog ser chen re re bzhin lag tu thogs la 'bul zhing*/ oṃ dzam+bhe mo ha ma ma bā su puṣ+ḍiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag bzlas la mchod pa 'bul/ gtor ma btang*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de ltar byas pas yo byad 'du long bag re byung na sgrub pa la brtson 'grus su bya/ ma byung na bsnyen pa log por bskyar dgos/ des mi 'grub mi srid do// me tog ma rnyed na 'bru la gi waṃ byugs pas/ de'i dod po yong gsungs so// nyer bzhi pa shes rab spel ba ni/ bdag bskyed sgrol dkar rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can tu bsgom/ bsnyen pa 'bum bskyar/ ser po khrag rkang*/ dong gra/ zi ra dkar nag pi pi ling*/ ru rta/ la la phud rnams zhib par btags la ra dmar mo'i mar dang 'o ma la sbyar ba'am/ yang na/ shu dag dkar po dang ser po khrag rkang sbyar ba dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag mdun bskyed 'khor du g.yas su dran pa'am/ mdun tu shes rab ma/ rgyab tu blo gros ma/ g.yon tu yid gzhungs ma ste 'khor bzhi gtso mo dang mtshungs par bsgom/ zla ba phyed du sgrub cing mchod/ yid bzhin 'khor lo spyi mtshungs bsgom/ yig bcu'i gsham du/ pradz+nyā ma ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ zhes btags pa bzla/ 'thung ba dang zos pas blo gros 'phral du 'phel bar 'gyur ro// yang na bdag bskyed lha lnga bsgoms pa'i gtso mo'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po 'od zer gyi phreng ba rgyun mi chad par byung bas/ lus gang*/ ngag gi dbang phyug thob par mos/ oṃ la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de/ oṃ hrīḥm hā mā yā dā+e ma hā sa ra swa t+yai na maḥ zhes mi smra ba yid bzlas bya/ shu dag

shing mngar/ rgyam tshwa/ a ru/ bca' lga/ la la phud/ ru rta/ pi ling*/ zi ra dkar nag sbyar ba'i ril bu rten tu byas la mdun bskyed bsgrub/ oṃ bāg+dā di ni ba tsarma ni yats+tsha sa ra swa tī ma hā shwe te swā hā/ zhes pa'ang bzlas la nangs mo mchod pa sngon tu 'gro bas ril bu zla ba gcig bsten na blo gros skye la/ drug bsten pas thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro// yang yig rnying ltar na/ sems bskyed/ rang mdun smin mtshams thad kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug lte bar tām̐/ rtsibs rnams la/ oṃ tu re pra dz+nyā dz+wā la sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes kha dog dkar pos bskor ba/ 'khor lo g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsam la ci nus bzla/ skyo na yid bzlas bya/ 'phro gcod dus 'khor lo snying gar bstim/ shin tu zab gsungs/ nyer lnga pa tshe spel pa'i las sbyor la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung bcud len gyi rnam grangs bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa las// sngags ni yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum// sgrol ma'i spyan sngar bzlas nas ni// zho dang sbrang rtsis sngar spags pa'i// dūrba'i myu gu'i rtse mo ni// shar dang byang bstan sbyin sreg bya// sngon gyi las las skyes ldang ba'i// 'chi ba'ang nges par zlog par byed// ces gsungs pa ltar nges par sgrub pa'i bzlas pa 'bru 'bum sngon tu song nas zho dang sbrang rtsis byugs pa'i dūrba'i myu gu ma nyams pa bung bsags la/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg sngar smos pa ltar la dūrba'i rdzas kho na grangs 'bum phrag la sogs pa ma song gi bar du snying po spel tshig can gyis rtse mo shar dang byang du bstan la 'bul bas rang gzhan gang yin pa'i tshe spel ba la mchog tu bsngags so// gnyis pa ni/ gshed dmar rgyud las/ a ru ra/ skyu ru ra/ bhṛṅga rā dza/ pi ling*/ na le sham/ lcags phye rnams sbrang dang ka ra sbyar bas ril bur dril la zla ba gcig zos pas tshe lo sum brgyar 'tsho bar bshad pa dang*/

slob dpon ko ki la'i tshe sgrub pa'i gdams ngag las sbyar sla ba ni/ mar dang sbrang rtsi 'o ma mnyam// snum pa'i snod la sbyar byas nas// nas kyi spang mar zhag gcig bzhag /de nas bton la nye bar bza'// so dang sen mo zla drug gis// brje 'gyur lo ni stong thub ste// rtags ni mig rno stobs ldan no// nye shing rtsa ba grib skam btags// 'o ma dang sbyar skrog pa'i mar// tho rangs zhag po nyer gcig za// nad sel lus yang lo drug zos// rnam rtog bral zhing tshe 'grub bo// zhes dang*/ 'bras bu gsum dang bh+ring ga'i phye// mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar la bza'// sman nyid zhu ba'i dus su ni// lo ma 'bras bskol bza' bar bya// mig rno nad med gsum brgya thub// sogs dang*/ 'bras bu gsum gyi lde gu ni// lcags kyi snod du bskus byas la// nyin mtshan gnyis ni khrus byas nas// mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar la bza'// lo gcig sbyor bas sum brgya thub// nad byang so dang sen mo brje// ko ki la 'dra'i skad ldan 'gyur// zhes sogs 'byung zhing*/ rtog pa las/ 'bras bu gsum ni spyir bsdus pa'am/ po so bh+riṅga rā dzar bcas// rnal 'byor pa yis rtag spyad na// bdud rtsi lnga yi bcud len te// gnyer ma skra dkar rnams dang bral// rdo rje'i lus bzhin gzugs bzang ldan// bskal pa la sogs grangs kyis ni// 'chi ba'ang nges par zlog pa yin// zhes bshad pa dag gam/ grub chen karma pas bzang drug dang bum rdzas sbyar ba'i ril bu bsgrubs nas zos pas srung ba dang tshe ring ba sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan par gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rtog pa dang gso dpyad kyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i rtsi bzhi dwangs ma lnga'i bcud len gyi ril bu sogs kyang 'di nyid kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin bsgrubs te bsten pas phan yon lhag par thob par 'gyur ro// 'dir bhṛṅga rā dza ste bung ba'i rgyal po zhes pa'i sman ni ming gi rnam grangs/

mārka/ ke sha rañdza sogs su grags pa skra nag por sgyur byed kyi bcud len gyi sman zhig ste ma rnyed na ra mo shag gis tshab rung ba rje btsun grags pas bzhed/ 'di thad 'chi slu gsar 'gyur du gong smos ltar snang yang*/ sngon dus bshad rgyun yod skabs kyi 'gyur rnying mchan can las/ so so bhṛṅga rā dza sogs dang*/ phan zhing bdud rtsir 'gyur ba ste/ zhes 'byung bas 'bras bu gsum phyogs gcig gam/ so so la bhṛṅga rā dza sbyar ba'i don dang*/ grangs lngar yang nges pa med pa rje bla mas bzhed la ko ki la'i bcud len dang yang 'grigs par snang*/ kun mkhyen chen pos gsar 'gyur gyi rgya dpe ma dag pa mang bas slar dpyad gzhir mdzad pa ltar gong 'og kun tu skad dod la the tshom che zhing*/ po so'i thad dar+pita zhes pa'ang yongs grags nga rgyal la 'jug gi po so la mi 'jug pa dang*/ po so ni ma nga na pa la ste myos byed 'bras bur grags pa bcud len tu mi 'gyur zhing*/ dar+bhita byas na byings don las so so'i skad dod du nges par 'gro bas rje bla ma'i gsung de legs par gsungs pa'o// gal te gzhan don tu tshe sgrub la sogs byed na bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi gzhung gong du smos pa ltar la/ sngags gsham ma ma zhes pa'i tshab tu bsrung bya'i ming sbyar ba ni khyad par ro// las tshogs 'di rnams sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la bsten cing kha cig dpa' bo gcig grub dang yang gcig par snang la rgyud sde sna tshogs las blangs pa'i man ngag gi dum bu phyogs su bsdebs pa mang mkhar ba blo gros bzang po'i sgrol dkar be'u bum sogs byin rlabs lag len gyi khungs dang ldan zhing lung rgyun bzhugs pa rnams las mdor bsdus pa ste/ rgyas par ni grub chen pak+shis sgrol dkar kho na'i las tshogs stong rtsa yod par gsungs pa ltar mtha' yas so// bdun pa lag len bshad pa la gsum/ bsnyen pa'i lag len/

bsnyen tshad/ sgrub pa las sbyor gyi lag len no// dang po ni/ bris sku bya thabs dang lag len dngos so// dang po ni/ dam tshig gi rten bris sku bya bar 'dod na rab bzhi'i tshes brgyad dam/ nya'i nyin mor lha 'phrod dge bsnyen yan chad kyi sdom pa dang ldan pas khrus dang gtsang sbra gso sbyong la gnas shing zas dkar gsum brten te nyi ma gcig la rab gnas bcas grub pa dang*/ khyad par nya drug 'dzom pa'i brgyad dam bco lnga la nyin rdzogs byas pa ni khyad par du gyur pa ste/ ma grub na tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du bris la yon lha bzo rang gis ji tsam 'dod pa sbyin no// bdag bskyed sgom bzlas dang*/ bum par yig bcu bzlas pa'i chus sku khrus gsol/ ras bris yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ spyan dbye/ snying po'i gsham du rten snying sbrel ba'i me tog dbu la gdags/ na bza' 'bul/ de nas yan lag bdun pa dang bzlas pa bya/ nyin rdzogs khyad par can gyi sku la cho ga gzhan med kyang*/ khrus dang rten snying mchod pa tsam mam/ me tog dbu la phul ba kho nas chog gsungs/ lugs sku sogs la'ang de bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ rab bzhi'i brgyad la sogs pa yar tshes gza' skar bzang po la babs ba'i tshe bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi dbu brtsam/ bris sku maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor sogs zhal lhor bstan la bsham/ 'di rgyas pa'i las sgrub gtso che bas rang nyid gdong byang du phyogs pas 'khod/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud khungs su byed pa ltar na gtsang sbra sogs ma grub kyang do gal chung mod/ 'on kyang jo bo chen po'i phyag srol dkyus su 'jag pa ltar rnam 'joms la sogs pa bzlas pa'i khrus chab kyis gnas khang yo byad rang dang bcas pa la khrus bya zhing bsnyen pa'i tshe sha chang sogs spangs nas rdor dkar gdan gcig grub na rab/ yun ring ba lta bus ma nus kyang sgog btsong sogs ngag gi nus pa nyams pa dang*/ chang dang gos ngan sogs gnyid rmugs nyams grib g.yeng ba 'byung ba'i rgyu rnams ring du spangs la gzungs chus khrus yang yang bya/

gal te gso sbyong la gnas par 'dod na slob dpon bha ba bha dras mdzad pa ltar legs/ thog mar 'di la 'jug pas 'grub pa'i skal pa yod med brtag na blo bzang pa'i yig cha ltar bya/ tshe bsod nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du tho rangs sam/ nyi shar nas thun gyi dbu btsugs te tshe khrid ltar nyams su len na sngon 'gro rgyas par dgos kyang bsnyen pa dkyus ma tsam la/ sngon gtor btang*/ sgo rtsar tho dkar po brtsigs pa rgyal chen bzhi'am bdud rtsi 'khyil par mnga' gsol/ yungs thun gu gul dud pa drag sngags sogs kyis bgegs bskrad la srung 'khor spyi 'gro brtan par bsgoms te bsnyen pa ma grol bar du mi bsdu bar yang yang gsal 'debs/ bsang chu bsgrub/ gnas yo byin rlabs byas la/ skyabs sems lan grangs nan tan dang*/ tshogs bsags nas brtsams bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar du btang la/ thog mar lha'i sku gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa gsal gdab la sems 'dzin/ de nas thugs ka'i yid bzhin 'khor lo gsal 'debs/ de dag la gsal snang ci rigs ma skyes bar du ngag bzlas la mi rngams par rtse gcig tu bsgom/ man ngag 'di'i lugs kyis 'khor lo yang thog mar rtsibs brgyad lte bar tām̐/ klad kor gyi steng du oṃ bya lding ba lta bu/ 'a 'dogs kyi 'og 'khor lo'i lte ba khong seng na hā/ rtsibs brgyad la 'bru brgyad bsgom par bzhed/ tshe sham sprel skabs bzlas dmigs dkyus ltar bsnan pa yin/ phyag mtshan me tog rtse mo gsum pa dang*/ 'khor lo mu khyud rim lngar dbyangs gsal rten snying rdo rwa me ris bskor ba ni ba ri lugs sogs kyi 'gres shor ba yin/ jo lugs rang rkang la med de rtsa ba'i rgya gzhung dang khungs thub kyi mkhas pa mang po'i yig char gsal ba ma zad/ bla ma'i zhal rgyun la'ang de ltar du 'byung ngo*// zhwa dmar drug pas ngag bzlas kyi tshe 'khor lo dang yig 'bru g.yas g.yon tu 'khor bar gsungs pa'ang 'jam dkar gyi 'gres shor ba ste gzhan gyis mi bzhed/

des na 'khor lo yig 'bru rnams g.yo med shin tu brtan pa/ dkar po 'od zer 'bar ba dang*/ sku mi 'gying drang por bsgom pa gnad du gsungs so// de ltar bsgoms pas gsal snang ci rigs skyes nas/ thog mar 'gog bzlas/ de nas rdor bzlas gang 'grub dang*/ spro bsdu bcas yi ge bcu pa'i ngag bzlas la thun gyi dngos gzhi bya/ thun mthar gsham can brgya rtsa re tsam bzlas kyang rung*/ skabs 'dir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin/ thun mthar mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim gnyis ka khyug tsam mam srod dang tho rangs thun mthar srung 'khor bzlas pa stong phrag tsam re/ thun gzhan gnyis kyi mjug gam gang bder tshe phur gdab pa tshar re bsgom/ thun mthar bsdu ldang dge bsngo grub nas gtor 'bul chag med du bya/ thun mtshams su bya ba'i rim pa gzhan bdun po thams cad chag med du 'grub dgos pa ma yin kyang re re la'ang dgos pa phan yon chen po dang ldan pas lag len tu gang thebs nges par bya'o// slar thun la 'jug pa ni/ skyabs sems nas brtsam/ gtor 'bul grub kyi bar btang nas yig bcu la bsnyen tshad rab 'bring tha ma gang rung ma song bar du de kho na ltar bya/ spyir 'di kho nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa'i lung dang lo rgyus rgya cher 'byung mod kyi/ skabs 'dir gtso bor tshe sgrub pa yin pas bsnyen tshad song nas dmigs gnad dkyus ltar la gtso bor tshe sham can bzla ba'i phyag len snang zhing de'i bar skabs su spyi bo'i 'od dpag med kyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das kyi bcud bdud rtsir bsdus/ phyag gi lhung bzed nang du zhugs/ zhu zhing khol ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun rang gi tshangs bug nas mar zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bar mos gsungs/ 'on kyang jo bo'i lugs kyi tshe sring ba'i dmigs pa'i gtso bo/ spro bsdu/ bzlas pa/ rdor bzlas/ srung 'khor/ tshe phur gdab pa lnga po yin pas dkyus su bstan pa nyid la mchog sgrub pa dang tshe sring ba'i dmigs gnad thams cad tshang bas ngag bzlas skabs thun gyi thog mthar gsham can cung zad re dang dngos gzhi yig bcu kho na bzlas kyang legs pa nyid do// gal te rang don bsnyen sgrub sngon tu song bas bla ma'i sku rim lta bur byed na/

'od zer gyis bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i bar chad bsal/ 'phags ma sgrol ma mchog gsum rtsa gsum dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs/ khyad par 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub/ brtan g.yo'i bcud la sogs pa bsdus/ bla ma la thim pas sku tshe mdzad phrin 'gro don mtha' dag rgyas par mos/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yin na rang gi spyi bor bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan la gang du bzhugs pa der thim par bsam/ sngags gsham ma ma'i tshab tu mtshan sngags sbyar/ gang zag gzhan la'ang des rigs 'gre/ tshe sgrub gtso bo'i bzlas pa'i skabs 'dir ni rab tu thun bzhi ka'i mthar/ 'bring du snga thun dang srod thun gnyis/ tha mas kyang snga thun gyi mjug tu mchod chog rgyas pa re nges par bya zhing*/ gzhan rnams la gtor 'bul kho na bya/ de'ang thun bsdu grub nas/ bsang chu dang gnas yo byin rlabs thun 'gor grub na 'dir mi dgos pas/ maṇ+ḍal dang rten la mdun bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs bskyed/ slar yang tshogs zhing spyan 'dren sogs mdun bskyed skabs ltar la/ ma lus sems mgon tsam las tshigs bcad rigs mi dgos/ sngags tsam gyis chog chu gnyis nyer spyod/ maṇ+ḍal/ bstod pa 'khor ba las sgrol/ gtor 'bul thun mtshams bya ba'i skabs bzhin dang*/ 'dod don gsol gdab sogs bya ba yin no// bgrang phreng dung shel gser sogs las mthun la rje dgu pa sogs kyis bya rgyud ltar/ oṃ ba su ma ti shrī ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ats+tshin+dha la swā hā/ zhes lan bdun la sogs pas byin gyis brlab par bzhed/ thun mtharabazlas pa'i kha skong dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying sogs bzla bar spro na'ang 'gal ba med do// spyod lam thams cad du rang rje btsun mar mos/ snang ba lha/ grags pa sngags/ dran rtog ye shes/ thams cad kyang bden med sgyu ma chos nyid kyi rol par lam du khyer/ zas skom 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la rang nyid lhar gsal ba la mchod pa'i tshul dang*/

gos stan rnams kyang 'bru gsum gyis ye shes rang snang gi rgyan tu byin gyis brlabs la longs spyod/ nyal ba'i tshe mtshan med rdzogs rim ltar stong pa la blo bzhag pa'am/ thugs srog gi bar du bsdus nas tām̐ yig la blo bzhag pa'am/ rang yi dam gsal ba'i thugs srog tām̐ yig 'od 'bar ba la sems gtad nas gnyid du 'gro ba gang bder bslab/ ldang ba'i tshe yi dam nam mkhar byon nas yi ge bcu pa'i sgras bskul bar bsams la ldang ngo*// gnyis pa bsnyen tshad la gsum/ dus/ rtags/ grangs so// dang po ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis ni// nges pa brtan pos zla drug bsgom// yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni// skyo ba med pa'i sems kyis bzla// zhes dang*/ de nyid kyi slob ma thu bos/ ched du zla ba drug gi bar// sgrol ma'i thugs kyi 'khor lo ni// bsgoms pas dngos grub kun thob cing*// 'chi ba'i skyon gyis mi gos so// zhes pa ni dus bsnyen rgyas pa'i lugs dang*/ 'bring zla gsum/ tha ma zla gcig la sogs par bzlas pa ci 'grub byas pas phan yon dpag tu med cing*/ yang mthar zhag bdun tsam la mtshams bcad de gus spro dang bcas te bzlas pas kyang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba zlog nus pa myong bas grub bo zhes kun mkhyen chen pos gsungs/ rab gnyid gcag sngags dang ma bral bar bgrangs na zhag bdun la 'grub cing grangs dus las lhag par 'grub na nges par zhal mthong zhing las rab 'byams 'grub ces rje dgu pas gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ rtags dngos las dang dngos grub rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba yin mod kyi/ de dag 'grub pa'i snga ltas tsam mam/ rje btsun mas byin gyis rlob cing rig sngags la nus pa mnga' ba'i rtags las dang po pa la nyams dang rmi lam du 'byung bar rigs pa ste/ slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas gtsug dri'i 'grel par/ rmi lam du byung ba ni rjes su spyod pa'i rtags te/

las dang po pas mang du brjod na bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa sngags kyi mthus rmi lam du shes par byed do// zhes gsungs so// des na rmi lam du bla ma gong ma thugs dgyes pa/ bud med chas bzang gyon pas spras pa dang dkar gsum sbyin cing lung ston pa/ gos dkar rgyan bzang thogs pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ rol mo bsgrags pa/ phyag mtshan mchod rten sku gzugs mjal ba/ 'jigs pa las thar pa sogs dang*/ khyad par gyi rtags/ sgre pa'i zhal nas/ me tog dang sāts+tsha rmis na 'chi ba dang bar chad bzlog pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mīs/ 'bum phrag gsum mam 'bum phrag drug /'bum phrag bcu bzlas las kun 'grub// ces dang*/ ngag dbang grags pas/ sngags ni yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum// zhes gsungs pas 'bru 'bum gcig bsnyen tshad yin la/ rtsod dus su ni bzhi 'gyur la sogs par bzla dgos pa'ang bzhed/ grub chen rin po ches/ yig bcu 'bum tsho brgya bzlas na yon tan 'phags ma sgrol ma dang mnyam par gsungs so// zhes gsungs shing*/ bye ba gcig song na las dang dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang bar bshad/ 'on kyang spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ 'di'i bsnyen pa 'bum tsho gcig bskyal na bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs/ 'di phrin las kyi lha yin pas 'grub sla zhing gegs med ces gsungs te rgyud kyi lo rgyus sogs las rgyas par bshad pa bzhin rgyu mtshan che bas yid ches pa'i gnas so// gsum pa ni/ bsnyen pa grub ma thag tu sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi bsham/ thun bzhi la bdag mdun bum pa sgrub cing gtor 'bul rjes chog bcas tshang bar byed pa las/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo mdun bskyed dang*/ gal te bum chu sgrub pa sogs dang 'brel na bum bzlas bung bskyed/ rjes kyi mchod bstod sogs mdor bsdus dang gshegs gsol mi bya bar brtan bzhugs kho na bya/ zhag bdun yan chad sgrub pa'i grangs thems nas/

bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gong bsnyen ji tsam 'grub pa'i bcu cha gcig nges par bya/ tshar lugs sogs kyis las sbyor gyi brdar bzhag pa bzhin/ dmigs bsal tshe spel bar 'dod na rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dus skabs de nyid dam gzhan tu'ang rung 'bum phrag la sogs pa'i grangs ji tsam mang ba legs pas de bzhin dang*/ gal te las tshogs su bshad pa'i srung 'khor la sogs pa bsgrub par 'dod na'ang sgrub pa'i mjug thog der zhag gsum bdun la sogs pa'am/ dus gzhan tu'ang rung bdag mdun bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas sgrub cing*/ sgrub pa zin pa'i rjes su rje dgu la sogs kyis bdag 'jug rgyas par bshad kyang 'dir btang snyoms su byas la/ spro na rjes gnang ltar rang gis blangs kyang 'gal ba med/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams ni rgyas par bya zhing bum chu sogs phyi mi la mi sbyin par dngos grub tu longs spyad/ mtshams kyi spang blang rnams ni spyi ltar shes dgos kyang*/ mdor na dad pa dang dam tshig gnyis la rags las te/ sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rtog pa las/ dad dang ldan pa'i mi rnams ni// sangs rgyas las kun 'grub par 'gyur// lha rnams kun dang khyad par du// gsang sngags rnams ni thams cad ni// dad pa med na mi 'grub bo// zhes dang*/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi mdo las/ me tog sad kyis khyer ba'i 'bras bu la// so nam byas kyang myu gu mi skye ltar// sdom nyams the tshom zos pa'i gang zag gis// shin tu zab pa'i rig sngags bsgrubs gyur kyang*// byin rlabs 'byung ngo snyam yang 'byung mi srid// rtsol ba de dag ngal ba don med 'gyur// rig sngags de yang skye bo'i tshig dang mtshungs// ting 'dzin rnams kyang byis pa'i bsam pa 'dra// skyon med skyes bus rig sngags de bsgrubs na// ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin tu myur du 'grub// dper na n+ya gro dha yi sa bon ni// shin tu phra yang chu lud legs bran na// dgun zla bdun na dpag tshad tsam du skye// bems po phyi yi 'gyur yang de 'dra na// rig pas rig pa bsgrub pa lta ci smos// 'od gsal nang gi 'gyur la dpag tu med// ces gsungs so// de dag yod du zin kyang cho ga log par bsgrubs na mda' med pa'i gzhu ltar don mi 'grub pas cho ga tshad ldan tu bsgrub pa gal che ste/

ral pa gyen brdzes las/ dngos grub dpal don gnyer ba'i mi// brgya byin bde sogs bdag po yang*// cho ga nyams na mi 'grub ste// cho ga yang dag ldan gyur na// mi yi skye bo phal pa la'ang*// 'bad pa yis ni las rnams kun// myur ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa la 'phrigs tshud de/ da lta lha 'di nyid la g.yar dam du 'cha' ba kha cig kyang cho ga nyams pa bzhir bzhag bzla tshul sogs mi tshe 'phul ba'i las thabs tsam du mthong nas kho bos kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin ci nus su phyes te rang gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pas so// brgyad pa de ltar bsgrubs pa'i phan yon mdor bsdus smos pa la gnyis/ rtsa sngags kyi phan yon/ sgom bzlas spyi'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las/ yi ge bcu pa gsungs pa'i 'phros su/ 'di ni dngos grub thams cad byed pa'o// zhes dang*/ las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud las/ 'jam dpal de'i phan yon ni mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga dang sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar 'gyur ro// mi khom pa brgyad du nam yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro// tshe rabs dran pa dang dbang po gsal ba dang yid gzhungs par 'gyur ro// bzo'i gnas thams cad la mkhas par 'gyur ro// stobs dang mdangs dang gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis srung ba dang skyob pa dang sbed pa dang phan par byed de/ gang du phyin pa thams cad du bkra shis par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ste mchog thun mong las tshogs dang bcas pa sngags 'di kho nas 'grub par byed do// gnyis pa/ yid bzhin 'khor lo sgom pa dang 'bri ba dang 'dogs pa dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i phan yon sgrol ma mngon 'byung las/ nad dang btson las thar ba dang*// tshe dang longs spyod brtson 'grus dang*// dbang phyug dang ni blo gros 'phel// zhes dang*/

slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba spu'i rtse mo'ang mi gcod par// 'chi bdag lta bur 'chi las rgyal// skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan dang*// nad dang dbul ba kun zad byed// seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad// sdug bsngal tshogs ni 'jig par byed// ma bslangs par ni zas skom sogs// khang bzang gos la sogs pa rnyed// ral gri mig sman rkang byug dang*// bum bzang la sogs dngos grub rnams// snyan ngag smra mkhas rtsod pa byang*// gcig tu dri med shes rab dang*// 'dod pa'i dngos grub gzhan dag kyang*// 'khor lo 'di las legs par 'byung*// zhes dang*/ grub chen pak+ṣis/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub yod// bya ba yin pas/ 'di la bsnyen sgrub tshad du skyol na yon tan rigs kyi yum lnga dang mnyam pa 'byung ba yin/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi'ang las kyi lha mor mnga' gsol ba sgrol ma yin pas 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol zhing skyob pa dang*/ bar chad thams cad srung ba'i phyir na sgrol ma zhes bya ba'i don de yin no// zhes dang*/ rje btsun grags pas/ mchog la bde mchog dang*/ thun mong la sgrol ma las zab pa dang myur ba med ces dbu bsnyung bzhes par grags shing*/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas/ thun mong lha la sgrol ma dang*// thun mong min la bde ba'i mchog /shin tu sgrub thag nye'o zhes// bla ma mchog gi gsung las byung*// 'di la gtan tshig bzang po mthong*// zhes gsungs te gtan tshigs ni rgyud dang lo rgyus gser phreng sogs las rtogs par 'gyur ro// rtag bde'i rang bzhin dngos kun za ma tog /rgyal ba nyi ma 'char ba'i zab gsal mkha'// 'gro drug sgrol mdzad zhabs sen zla ba ni// ral pa'i khri la 'bral ba med par bsti// ring du 'tsho dang thar pa don gnyer ba// mtho ris 'jig rten nor gyi mchog sgrub na// mtshungs med thabs 'di skom pas bdud rtsi bzhin// mi bsten mi yi 'gro ba 'ga' yod dam// dri med gzhung lugs zla ba'i me long na// 'tsho thabs bdud rtsi'i re khā rdzogs pa las// 'chi med dgos rgu'i 'dod pa 'jo ba gang*// 'phags ma'i byin rlabs ri mor shar ba snyam// rang dang gzhan la phan 'dod blo gros kyis// gsal bar phyes 'dir grong khyer lam srang ltar// zhugs nas 'chi med rtag pa'i khang bzang du// rdo rje btsun mo'i rgyal srid la spyod shog

/dus min dus kyi chad pa phyir bsnyil ba'i// rnam rgyal sa la mi phyed rdo rje bzhi// grub pa'i bcud len mkha' khyab 'gro ba la// sbyin byed 'jig rten gsum gyi yum gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mkhyen nus brtse ba'i gter chen mchog gis yang yang bka' stsal gnang ba gtsug tu mchod nas/ sgrol ma bla med dang jo bo lugs dang ba ri lugs kyi tshe khrid rigs gnyis gtsos 'di nyid kyi lugs srol mang du thos shing cung zad khong du chub pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i zhabs pad rigs bdag tu byed pa'i dge sbyong ltar snang ba karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos/ rje dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha/ kun mkhyen dharmā ka ra sogs byin rlabs dang lung rgyun ldan pa'i gsung gsang 'don cha'i rigs bslad med gzhir bzhag rgyud dang yig rnying gi dgongs pa phyogs su bsdebs te 'dus shing gsal bar dpal spungs yang dben kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du dkar po'i gral tshes zla ba gro bzhin la spyod pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang por/ rgyas pa'i dus kyi char 'grub par bgyis pa dpal ldan bla ma dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams zhabs pad rdo rje ltar brtan cing*/ mtha' yas pa'i skyed gus rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsang ba gsum 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig dge legs 'phel// ༈ /sgrol dkar ril sgrub kyi lag len bzhugs so// no mo ār+yā tā rā yai/ sgrol dkar ril bu sgrub tshul yig rnying las don gyis bstan cing*/ grub chen karma pa sogs kyis che thang du gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas grub kyi skyes bu mang pos phyag gzhes bar ma chad par mdzad pa'i tshe'i nor bu bsgrub par 'dod pas/ rgyud dang grub chen rnams kyi dgongs pa ltar/ 'bras bu gsum cha mnyam/ de gsum dang cha mnyam bhṛṅga rā dza'am ma rnyed na ra mo shag dus brkos te sman sna zhi dang*/

bzang po drug lnga tshan lnga rnams rtsa bar sbyar/ nus skyed kyi yan lag tu rtsa ba lnga dang*/ rtag du rigs gsum/ khyad par rgyud yan lag brgyad pa las gsungs pa/ cong zhi/ brag zhun/ bu raṃ/ sbrang rtsi/ mar gsar 'o ma dang bcas te dwangs ma lnga dang*/ shug 'bru/ ba lu/ 'tshe/ mkhan dkar te bdud rtsi bzhi bcas rgyud de nyid las bshad pa'i phyag len tshad ldan tu sbyar ba ste sman rnams gtsang zhing dag pa dang*/ gong ma rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril dang tshe chu ril bu sel med skyobs su sbyar te gla ba'i ril ma tsam las mi chung ba'i ril bu zla ba'i mdangs can skam thag chod pa dang*/ gu gul dud pas bdug cing sbyong ba bgegs bskrad khrus gsol legs par byas nas/ bum pa che tshad kha rgyan mgul chings dang ldan pa'i nang du blugs la gzungs thag btags te dkyil 'khor du bkod/ tshe bsod rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa mtshon slad na bza' ser po gsol kyang rung*/ bdag mdun bum pa'i sgrub tshul spyir gzhung bshad kho na ltar las/ khyad par bum bskyed skabs/ nang du lnga tshan lnga sogs bcud kyi ril bus yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ zhes dang*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs ril bu rnams la thim pas 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len gyi mchog tu gyur/ ces dang*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu zhu ba ril bu rnams dang dbyer med par gyur/ ces bsgyur/ rjes chog skabs brtan bzhugs nan tan dang rten 'brel snying po la/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha btags pa lan bdun la sogs pa brjod/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu de byin nus dgos pa mchog dang ldan pa yin pas gza' skar bzang po'i tho rangs nas brtsam/ rgyun tu re re bstan cing dam tshig mi gtsang ba dang sdig can sogs la sbyin par mi bya'o// zhes pa'ang sngar brtsams pa'i cho ga'i zur 'debs su blo gros mtha' yas kyis so// dge legs 'phel// ༈ /sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgom bzlas rdo rje'i ya lad ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/

brtse ldan 'jigs pa kun skyob ma// myur mdzad dpa' mo la btud nas// gang zhig dran na 'jigs sel ba// rgyud dang grub pa'i gsung bzhin 'chad// gang sgrub pa po yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa thems shing ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang ci rigs skyes pas 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i las bye brag la lag tu len par 'dod na/ skyabs sems sngon tu btang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du rang sems tām̐ ljang gu las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las ut+pal sngon po tām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ pā la sha'i kha dog ltar ljang gu/ phyag dang po gnyis ut+pa la'i phyag rgya thugs kar 'ching ba/ lhag ma g.yas gsum phreng ba dkar po mda' chen 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum rgyal mtshan gzhu/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan 'od zer 'phro ba'i sku dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mchod/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag spyi bor 'khyil pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da'i bar/ lha dang lha min sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ thugs kar pad zla la 'khor lo ljang gu rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐/ de'i mthar mdun nas g.yas skor gyis/ oṃ māṃ sarba bha ye bh+yo rak+ṣa hā/

gzhan srung na māṃ gyi mal du gang bsrung ba'i ming gzhug rtsibs brgyad la 'bru brgyad/ de tsam mam/ rgyas par spro na/ de'i phyi rol mu khyud bdun dang ldan pa'i dang po la ye dhar/ gnyis par rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥhā bsrung bya la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gsum par dbyangs gsal/ bzhi par 'khyil ba'i phreng sngags so/ gzungs/ lnga par ral gri tām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ drug pa la hūm̐ yig bdun par me dpung gi phreng bas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang kha dog ljang gu/ 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa bsal nas sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus 'khor lo la thim pas nus stobs mchog tu 'bar bar gyur/ ces mos la rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa grangs sam rtags mthong du bzla zhing*/ thun mthar gsham can yang brgya rtsa tsam re bzlas la mchod bstod bya/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad rang nyid la 'dus/ rang thugs ka'i 'khor lo/ de tām̐ yig de'ang mas rim gyis yal te spros pa kun dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid do// slar skad cig gis 'phags ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya/ 'di nyid rgyud nas dngos su bstan cing 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i sgom bzlas rnams kyang 'di'i yan lag yin pas bsnyen pa zur du thon na legs shing*/ gal te mi 'grub pa'am mi spro bar sgrol dkar lta bu'i rnal 'byor la brten nas las tshogs 'di rnams sbyar bar 'dod na/ sgrol dkar nyid phyag brgyad sgrol mar gnas 'gyur ba'am/ sgrol dkar rnal 'byor kho nas kyang rung ste/ sngon la yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas sgom cung zad re byas nas 'jigs skyob sgrol ma gang yin pa de thugs ka nas spro// bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/

mthar mtshan brgya gang 'grub 'don/ slar lha mo rang gi thugs kar bsdus la bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bya'o// de la dang po seng ge stag gzig dred spyang sogs gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa srung ba ni/ rang gi thugs las lha mo seng ge'i gdong*// nag mo 'khor lo me dpung 'dzin pa ni// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer gyis// gdug pa'i gcan gzan lus rengs sems rmongs shing*// kha bcings yul khams gzhan tu bskrad par gyur// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba bha ya sha ma ni sarba durga ti tā ra ni tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// gnyis pa glang chen ma he g.yag rgod sogs phyugs kyi 'jigs pa srung ba ni/ rang gi thugs las lha mo glang chen gdong*// dud ka gsus pa 'phyang zhing mche ba gtsigs// g.yas g.yon ral gri sharbu la bsnams pa// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer gyis// 'tshe sems ldan rnams sems dngangs lus 'dar zhing*// drag shul sbyor bas bskrad cing byer bar gyur// oṃ dī ra da/ ba da ni e ka daṃṣ+ṭī mahā na se lam+bodha ri kar+dha kar+dha tra sa ya tra sa ya sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ gsum pa dgon gnas grong khyer nags tshal sogs la me'i 'jigs pa srung ba ni/ rang gi thugs las drag mo me yi mdog /zhal ras bdun mnga' ljags bdun glog ltar skyod// phyag gnyis nor bu chu yi dal bsnams pa// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer gyis// chu rgyun chen pos me yi 'jigs 'joms gyur// oṃ shi khī ba da ne ma hā ulkā mu khī/ dz+wa la mā li nī sab+ta dzi hī/ sap+ta mu khī bi shwa na ri tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ bzhi pa dug thams cad dang*/ sbrul sdigs sogs khung bur gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyi 'jigs pa skyob pa ni/ rang gi thugs las lha mo chu shel mdog /sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun ldan sbrul rgyan can// phyag bzhis bum pa sbrul zhags nor bu dang*// sman gyi dbang po'i snod 'dzin yid tsam khro// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer ni// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis brtan g.yo'i dug rigs rnams// ba mor nyi zer phog bzhin bcom par gyur// oṃ pa nī ma hā pa nī kṛṣ+ṇa no tri e ka da na dzi hwī ka re ṇa/

tsa lā ya tsa lā ya mahā bi ṣa bha k+ṣi ni tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ lnga pa chom rkun dgra jag sogs mi'i 'gro ba'i gnod pa srung ba ni/ rang gi thugs las khro mo mig sman mdog /dbu skra gyen brdzes phyag drug ral gri mdung*// dgra s+t+wa mda' gzhu phub chung 'dzin pa ni// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer gyis// gnod byed thams cad rmongs bskrad dbye rengs sogs// tshar bcad bsrung bya mi 'jigs go ldan gyur// oṃ khaḍ+ga ha sti bhṛ ku ṭī mu khī ud+dha ke sha ma hā na di kṛṣ+ṇa añdza na bhar+ṇa tsin+da tsin+da bhin+da bhin+da ut+ta ra ya tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ drug pa btson ra lcags sgrog zhags pa chad pa sogs rgyal po'i 'jigs pa srung ba ni/ rang gi thugs las sprul pa'i lha mo ni// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan zhi ma khro// g.yas bzhis lcags kyu g.yon bzhis zhags pa bsnams// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer gyis// sems bsgyur yid g.yos khros pa'i ngar zhi nas// brtse zhing chags te bcings pa rang grol gyur// oṃ rak+ta war+ṇe pā shāṅku sha ha sti mahā ra bi/ mahā ba la sa ra sa ra bi sa ra/ gṛh+na gṛh+na ā kar+bha ā kar+bha mahā durga na mu tsā latā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ bdun pa chu chen gru zam shwa sgud sogs chu'i 'jigs pa srung ba ni/ rang gi thugs las lha mo gser gyi mdog /g.yas g.yon ri rab sa yi dkyil 'khor bsnams// nor bu me 'bar phung po la gnas pa// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer gyis// mar la lcags sreg phog bzhin chu rgyun skems// chu 'dre tshar bcad mā ki'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ dza le dza le mahā dza le tā ra ya tā ra ya u tā ra ya u tā ra ya/ shṛṅkha la ha sti mahā dza we e ka bī ri mahā kā ru ṇe tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ brgyad pa sha za srin po gnod sbyin gza' klu sogs gdon gyi 'jigs pa skyob pa ni/

rang gi thugs las lha mo zla ba'i mdog /phyag bcu dang pos skyabs sbyin chos 'byung 'dzin// lhag ma brgyad kyis gdon chen bco brgyad sdigs// bcu phrag zhabs kyis gdon chen rnam par gnon// dpag med spros pa'i mthu dang 'od zer gyis// gdon bgegs bsregs mnan bsdigs shing gzir nas kyang*// dbang med rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad par gyur// oṃ mahā gam ghī re ye mahā kā ru ṇi ka bha ga wāṃ bā le ba ra da a bha ya ha s+t+wi tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes sngags mang du bzla/ 'di dag gi rjes kyi bya ba ni gong du smos pa ltar ro// de'ang bsnyen sgrub grangs rtags sngon tu thems pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rang gzhan gang yang rung bar 'jigs pa de dag byung ma thag sgom bzlas bya ba'i tshul ni bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ ma byung ba'i snga rol nas srung 'dod pas/ sgrol dkar chog gzhung las tshogs skabs su bshad pa'i srung 'khor che ba spel tshig kha bsgyur so sor bcas bri gzhi dkar por tsan+dan dkar po'i khu ba bsres pa'i rdzas kyis bris pa dang lhan cig lte ba'i thad du 'jigs skyob so so'i sngags byang shog bu gru bzhir phreng du bris te gzhug la rab gnas skabs/ 'jigs skyob so so'i lha rang thugs nas spros bskyed bstims mchod zhu ba sogs byas nas bsrung bya la gdags pa'am/ so so'i sku dang sngags byang rab gnas ldan pa'am/ ma 'grub na srung skud dkar po la mdud pa bor te 'jigs skyob kyi lhar bsgoms nas sngags gdab cing btags pas kyang srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// tshul bzhin bsgrubs na smos ci dgos// dran pa tsam gyis 'jigs skyob ma'i// sgom bzlas rgyud bzhin bris pa'i dges// lus can gtan gyi 'jigs sel shog /ces pa'ang skye dgu la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i go cha gzod nas bzhes pa/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka' lung rjes su sgrub slad/

sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon po'i phyag mtshan can gyi dgongs pa ma 'khrul ba khyer bder bsdebs pa ste blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang khrod du'o// dge legs 'phel// ༈ /sgrol dkar smon lam bsam 'grub lha'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ru ār+yā tā rā ye/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i yum mchog rje btsun ma// yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang bcas// gshegs bzhugs 'du 'bral med kyang gnyug ma'i rtsal// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pas bslad pa'i snang tshul du// sngon gyi thugs dam chen po deng bskul na// gsol 'debs bu la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te// mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor snying dbus dri med mkha'// bde chen 'khor lor byang chub snying po'i bar// rtag brtan zhi ba ther zug ngo bo ru// bzhugs nas ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs stsol// don dam skyabs gsum rang bzhin 'phags ma'i 'phrul// 'khor 'das spros bral ngang du mnyam phyag 'tshal// dmigs med snying rje ris med dam chos bzung*// tshad med zhing sbyong kun bzang mchod pas mchod// 'khor gsum gdod nas ma grub lta ba'i mkhar// dug gsum nyes pa'i rgyu 'bras stongs pas bshags// 'dus ma byas pa kun khyab bde gshegs snying*// zag med dge ba'i phul la rjes yi rang*// brjod pa las 'das stong nyid chos kyi rnga*// srid zhi kun 'gengs dbyangs su brdung du gsol// skye ba med pas 'gag pa'i mtha' bral phyir// mi gnas gnas pa chen por bzhugs su gsol// sems can byang chub gnyis su ma grub pas// chos rnams ngo bo yongs grub gshis su bsngo// sems can thams cad rab tu dgrol slad du/ sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa'i mdo tshig /byang chub sems ni bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// bdag gis sems can thams cad mgron tu gnyer// bdud rtsi'i bde bas yang dag tshims par bgyi// gnyid kyis rab log sems can shes rab kyi// mthu dang sgrub pas rnam par sad par bgyi// rnam par 'phrul ba mtha' las ston byed cing*// bde bar gshegs bka' yid 'ong ye shes dang*// chags pa med pa'i spyod mchog ston par bgyi// rgyal ba rnams kyis shin tu bsngags mdzad pa// mkhas pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dpal dbyangs// rje btsun sgrol mas byang chub spyod mdzad pa// thams cad ma lus bdag gis slob par bgyi// de dag la sogs zhing rdul grangs snyed kyi// mi mchog dpa' bo dus gsum gshegs rnams kyi// thugs bskyed smon lam rnam thar ting nge 'dzin// ma lus bdag gzhan kun gyis 'grub par shog

/bdag dang pha ma mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// skye ba 'di nas byang chub ma thob par// bsam bzhin srid par 'jug pa ma gtogs pa// ma dag zhing dang ngan 'gror mi skye shog /dag pa'i zhing skyes mngon par shes dang ldan// sangs rgyas byang sems yang dag dge ba'i bshes// mjal zhing rjes bzung thugs yid gcig tu 'dres// log lta dam sel ming yang mi grags shog /skye ba kun tu byang sems mi brjed cing*// theg chen chos spyod dge ba'i grogs dang 'grogs// khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te// tshe gcig gdod ma'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /bslab pa gsum dang rdo rje'i dam tshig la// nyams chags 'gal sogs sdig ltung sgrib pa'i las// sngar bsags ma lus gtan nas byang ba dang*// phyin chad rmi lam du yang mi 'byung shog /mtho ris yon tan bdun thob khyad par du// nad med tshe dang 'grib med bsod nams dang*// dri med blo gros yar ngo'i zla ba dang*// dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur rgyas par shog /thos bsam sgom byung shes rab mkha' ltar yangs// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i snang ba nye bzhin brdal// mkhyen brtse nus pa rgya mtsho'i sprin chen las// mkha' mnyam smin grol bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shog /bdud kyi las rnams rtag tu spong ba dang*// chos spong las kyis nam yang mi bsgribs shing*// chos dang yon tan kun gyi snod gyur nas// phyogs dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin byed shog /dpa' bo snying stobs chen po dus gsum du// gshegs rnams rnam thar bdag nyid kho nas bzlum// sras bcas rgyal bas yal bar 'dor ba yi// rmu rgod ji snyed bdag gis 'dul bar shog /smon lam dbang gis srid la mtshams sbyor kyang*// mi khom brgyad dang khyad par lta spyod log /zog po khrims 'chal sdig spyod rgyal blon 'bangs// dug chang smad 'tshongs thon pa mu stegs can// lus ngag yid kyi dbang por skyon zhugs pa// mdor na gzhan la gnod cing rang rgyud la// yon tan skye ba'i rgyu rkyen ma tshogs pa'i// 'gro ba'i lus su nam yang mi skye shog

/sgo gsum kha na ma tho'i skyon bral zhing*// mthong thos dran reg thams cad rang bzhin gyis// thar pa'i sa la kha lo sgyur nus pa'i// sprul pa'i lus mchog dpag med 'gyed par shog /'di nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*// rmi lam du yang 'bral ba ma mchis par// rjes su bzung nas byin gyis rlob par shog /bag chags dri ma'i tshogs kyis mi bsgribs par// mtshan dpe'i sku mchog mngon sum mthong ba dang*// tshangs dbyangs gsung gi gdams pa rgyun tu nod// bde stong thugs kyi dbyings dang ro mnyam shog /nad gdon sdig sgrib glo bur ye 'drog dang*// 'jigs pa bcu drug dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen// mi mthun gnod pa mtha' dag rje btsun ma'i// zhabs pad dran pa'i mod la zhi gyur cig /lung rtogs yon tan 'byor pa'i phun tshogs drug /khyad par chos bzhin ring du 'tsho ba'i mchog /mngon par 'dod pa'i don 'bras ci yang rung*// rje btsun thugs rje can mas myur stsol shog /'phags mas bdag gi co to nas bzung ste// nyes pa'i lam las rtag tu ldog pa dang*// legs pa'i lam la rtag tu 'khrid pa sogs// ma yis bu gcig bzhin tu bskyang gyur cig /nam zhig bem rig bral tshe gnad gcod kyi// sdug bsngal tshor ba spu tsam mi myong bar// lhan skyes mdzes ma shes rab phar phyin zhal// mthong ba'i dga' bas gzhi thog rang grol shog /srid pa bar do rmi lam tsam shar yang*// skad cig de ru bcom ldan 'das ma byon// mngon sum lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste// bde ba can gyi zhing du 'khrid par shog /tshe rabs 'di dang lus rten 'di nyid las// srid pa gzhan tu nying mtshams mi sbyor bar// bdag dang bdag gi 'brel thogs 'gro ba kun// 'od dpag med kyi zhing du skye bar shog /las kyi dbang gis zhing mchog mi bgrod na// skye gzhan mi 'khyams mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba bcas// ri bo ta lar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i drung*// mda' 'phangs bzhin tu skye ba len par shog
